##### Heat Stable Proteins

Improve workflow consistency with our expanded portfolio of heat stable AI-Engineered Designer
Proteins. 

[ Improve Consistency ][118]

##### Rapid 90-Minute ELISAs

[ELISA Kits]

Discover newly available targets with rapid, reliable Quantikine™ QuicKits that deliver accurate
data in just 90 minutes.

[ View Products ][119]

##### Human Luminex Discovery Assays

[Luminex® NHP XL Cytokine Panel]

Targets now include **TIMP-1, TIMP-2, TIMP-3**, and **TIMP-4,** giving you deeper insights into
ECM. 

[ Build Your Panel ][120]

## Highlights

##### Tocris™ Small Molecules and Peptides

[Tocris Small Molecules Homepage Teaser]

Explore our diverse range of bioactive small molecules - receptor agonists/antagonists, inhibitors,
PROTACs, and fluorescent probes for cutting-edge research.

[ Browse Selection ][121]

##### Validated Antibodies

[Vials of R&D Systems validated antibodies]

Application-specific validation ensures dependable antibodies that deliver exceptional, and
expected, performance.

[ Learn More ][122]

##### Luminex® MAGPIX Instrument

[Luminex Magpix Homepage Teaser]

xMAP*^{®}* technology is now accessible to everyday labs with the Luminex MAGPIX*^{®}* instrument.

[ Start Multiplexing ][123]

##### Tailor-Made Reagents

From flexible sizes, formats and formulations to fully customized products, we specialize in meeting
your unique needs.

[ Explore Options ][124]

##### Closed System Solutions

[Closed Systems GMP Bag Teaser BG]

Scale cell therapy manufacturing with simplicity. GMP cytokines, media, and AB serum in single-use
bags for closed process workflows.

[ View Selection ][125]

##### On-Demand Antibody Conjugation

[Antibody Conjugation Homepage Teaser]

Pair the antibody you trust with the label you need. Single-vial, made-to-order conjugation with 30+
labels, including Alexa Fluor™ Plus. 

[ Learn More ][126]

##### Cancer Research

Advance cancer research with rigorously validated reagents for studying immune checkpoints, the
tumor microenvironment, and beyond.

[ Explore Resources ][128]

##### Cell Therapy

Ensure a seamless transition to the clinic with consistent, scalable solutions and automated
instruments.

[ Uncover Solutions ][129]

##### Stem Cells & Organoids

Explore advanced solutions for robust, reproducible stem cell and organoid culture, differentiation,
and analysis.

[ Accelerate Discoveries ][130]

# Summer 2026 graduations are here

## Celebrate your achievements

Now your studies are complete, it’s time to celebrate everything you've achieved with your loved
ones in the magnificent surroundings of Bath Abbey.

It's a moment to reflect on your university experience, look ahead to the future, and receive the
award you've worked so hard for.

## Raise a glass at your graduation reception

After the ceremony, join your department’s drinks reception to celebrate with friends, family,
tutors, and other University staff who have supported you throughout your studies.

## Hot weather forecast during graduations

Bath Abbey will be hot during the graduation ceremonies.

To help yourself keep cool, please bring:
* your own water bottle - we're not able to provide drinking water in the Abbey

You don't need to wear a suit jacket during the ceremonies, but you should wear light and breathable

# Think Antibodies.
# Think Bio-Rad.

Find Antibodies, Reagents, and Expert Advice.

## Featured Products

[ [StarBright™ Dyes]][168]

### [StarBright™ Dyes][169]

StarBright Dyes are highly stable, ultra-bright, with narrow spectra and flexible integration,
enabling bigger, better flow panels with ease.
[ [TrailBlazer™ StarBright™ Dye Label Kits]][170]

### [TrailBlazer™ StarBright™ Dye Label Kits][171]

Don’t compromise, label your antibody of choice to superior StarBright Dyes for flexibility in your
assays.
[ [Market-Leading Anti-Idiotypic Antibodies]][172]

### [Market-Leading Anti-Idiotypic Antibodies][173]

Accurately assess biotherapeutics with Bio-Rad’s range of highly specific, high-affinity
anti-idiotypic antibodies.

## Custom Services

[View All Custom Antibody Services][174]
[ [Discover SpyTag and SpyCatcher Products]][175]

### [Discover SpyTag and SpyCatcher Products][176]

Increase your design possibilities and build better antibodies with SpyTag and SpyCatcher
technology.
[ [Create Custom-Made Antibodies with HuCAL® Technology]][177]

### [Create Custom-Made Antibodies with HuCAL® Technology][178]

Generate highly specific, fully human, recombinant antibodies with our custom antibody generation
service.
[ [Quote Request for Bulk or Customized Catalog Antibodies]][179]

### [Quote Request for Bulk or Customized Catalog Antibodies][180]

Bio-Rad offers two options for the generation of large quantities of the antibodies in our catalog,
either on a one-off basis or as part of a long-term arrangement.

### Accelerate Drug Discovery with the Pioneer™ Antibody Discovery Platform

The Pioneer Antibody Discover Platform is specifically designed to develop best-in-class biologic
candidates. It features a state-of-the-art phage display library engineered to include more than 200
billion unique sequences and can identify high-affinity antibody candidates using our newly
developed, proprietary SpyDisplay technology.

We deliver a bespoke antibody discovery service for each client based on their unique requirements.
From challenging targets to pH-sensitive antibodies and bispecifics, we can help you accelerate your
drug candidate discovery.
 

[Learn about our Antibody Platform][181]

[ [Accelerate Drug Discovery with the Pioneer™ Antibody Discovery Platform]][182]

## Popular Resources

[ [Flow Cytometry Experiment Planning]][183]

### [Flow Cytometry Experiment Planning][184]

To help you keep track of all your experimental details, Bio-Rad has generated a range of handy
planners to organize, record, and streamline your flow cytometry workflow. Use them to document
steps such as antibody selection, instrument settings, and analysis to ensure reliable and
reproducible research.
[ [Course Seven of Antibody Essentials: Working with Your Antibody — Controls Part 2]][185]

### [Course Seven of Antibody Essentials: Working with Your Antibody — Controls Part 2][186]

Enroll in course 7 of our Antibody Essentials Series. For anyone working with antibodies who wants
to strengthen their knowledge of best practices, optimise workflows, and achieve more reliable
results.
[ [Multicolor Panel Builder]][187]

### [Multicolor Panel Builder][188]

Select or create an instrument, choose your targets and species, add all desired markers, then pick
antibodies by clone, isotype, and format. If a format isn’t available, use the fluorophore
placeholder. Add a viability dye or dump channel as needed.
[ [30% Off Secondary Antibodies]][189]

### 30% Off Secondary Antibodies

**Promotion Period: 01-July-2026 to 30-September-2026**

Secondary reagents have been carefully selected to provide optimum quality and flexibility for your
experimental design, offering a choice of monoclonal or polyclonal antibodies, IgG molecules or
F(ab’)₂ fragments, and a wide range of formats to support your workflow across applications
including flow cytometry, western blotting, and immunocytochemistry, while minimizing
cross-reactivity with cross-adsorbed antibodies and enabling multiplex western blotting with
exceptionally bright fluorescent StarBright™ Dye secondary antibodies.
 

[Find Out More][190]

### [TrailBlazer™ StarBright™ Dye Label Kits][171]

Don’t compromise, label your antibody of choice to superior StarBright Dyes for flexibility in your
assays.
[ [Market-Leading Anti-Idiotypic Antibodies]][172]

### [Market-Leading Anti-Idiotypic Antibodies][173]

Accurately assess biotherapeutics with Bio-Rad’s range of highly specific, high-affinity
anti-idiotypic antibodies.

## Custom Services

[View All Custom Antibody Services][174]
[ [Discover SpyTag and SpyCatcher Products]][175]

### [Discover SpyTag and SpyCatcher Products][176]

Increase your design possibilities and build better antibodies with SpyTag and SpyCatcher
technology.
[ [Create Custom-Made Antibodies with HuCAL® Technology]][177]

### [Create Custom-Made Antibodies with HuCAL® Technology][178]

Generate highly specific, fully human, recombinant antibodies with our custom antibody generation
service.
[ [Quote Request for Bulk or Customized Catalog Antibodies]][179]

### [Quote Request for Bulk or Customized Catalog Antibodies][180]

Bio-Rad offers two options for the generation of large quantities of the antibodies in our catalog,
either on a one-off basis or as part of a long-term arrangement.

### Accelerate Drug Discovery with the Pioneer™ Antibody Discovery Platform

The Pioneer Antibody Discover Platform is specifically designed to develop best-in-class biologic
candidates. It features a state-of-the-art phage display library engineered to include more than 200
billion unique sequences and can identify high-affinity antibody candidates using our newly
developed, proprietary SpyDisplay technology.

We deliver a bespoke antibody discovery service for each client based on their unique requirements.
From challenging targets to pH-sensitive antibodies and bispecifics, we can help you accelerate your
drug candidate discovery.
 

[Learn about our Antibody Platform][181]

[ [Accelerate Drug Discovery with the Pioneer™ Antibody Discovery Platform]][182]

## Popular Resources

[ [Flow Cytometry Experiment Planning]][183]

### [Flow Cytometry Experiment Planning][184]

To help you keep track of all your experimental details, Bio-Rad has generated a range of handy
planners to organize, record, and streamline your flow cytometry workflow. Use them to document
steps such as antibody selection, instrument settings, and analysis to ensure reliable and
reproducible research.
[ [Course Seven of Antibody Essentials: Working with Your Antibody — Controls Part 2]][185]

### [Course Seven of Antibody Essentials: Working with Your Antibody — Controls Part 2][186]

Enroll in course 7 of our Antibody Essentials Series. For anyone working with antibodies who wants
to strengthen their knowledge of best practices, optimise workflows, and achieve more reliable
results.
[ [Multicolor Panel Builder]][187]

### [Multicolor Panel Builder][188]

Select or create an instrument, choose your targets and species, add all desired markers, then pick
antibodies by clone, isotype, and format. If a format isn’t available, use the fluorophore
placeholder. Add a viability dye or dump channel as needed.
[ [30% Off Secondary Antibodies]][189]

### 30% Off Secondary Antibodies

**Promotion Period: 01-July-2026 to 30-September-2026**

Secondary reagents have been carefully selected to provide optimum quality and flexibility for your
experimental design, offering a choice of monoclonal or polyclonal antibodies, IgG molecules or
F(ab’)₂ fragments, and a wide range of formats to support your workflow across applications
including flow cytometry, western blotting, and immunocytochemistry, while minimizing
cross-reactivity with cross-adsorbed antibodies and enabling multiplex western blotting with
exceptionally bright fluorescent StarBright™ Dye secondary antibodies.
 

[Find Out More][190]

The best biologics solution expert.

### [Protein Engineering
### Production][179]

We have more than 10 years of experience in gene synthesis and molecular construction. We can
provide you with customized expression, purification and characterization.

### [Viral Vectors & Cell
### Engineering][180]

We provide you with viral vector and cell engineering services. Our viral vector platforms include
but not limited to baculovirus, AAV and lentivirus.

### [Antibody Discovery
### & Engineering][181]

We can reformat the antibody variable region genes (VH and VL) from a given antibody to encode
different constant regions and other formats, including Fab, scFv, IgM, nanobodies and bispecific
molecules.

### [Protein Chemistry][182]

CD BioSciences provides customized labeling and conjugation services, chemical modification
services, etc. for proteins and antibodies, as well as large-scale conjugation and customized
conjugation.

### Our main business is to provide integrated biological solutions

CD BioSciences has established a series of collaborative technology platforms to advance
projects from discovery to development to manufacturing.

## Centrifugal Blue®Washer - 
## Meet the New Standard

Since winning SLAS and MipTec new product awards in 2015, Blue® Washer has become the new standard
for media change in cellular assays and no-tip magnetic bead* separation in NGS library prep. Most
top 25 pharma companies and top clinical diagnostics labs now use Blue® Washers to obtain better
cellular assay data and to cut run time and save tips for NGS library prep.

## Watch Now

[
][44]
Features, applications, possibilities. 
See the Blue®Washer in action.

## Drive your applications with the centrifugal Blue®Washer and Blue®CatX platform

[

#### Cellular Assays

][45][Centrifugal media evacuation reduces background and variability in cellular assay data,
reducing %CV and improving z’ by 0.1 to 0.3. Higher z’ means more reliable compound profiles!
][46]
[

#### CELL WASH FOR SPHEROIDs AND organoids

][47][Blue®Plate enables fully automated, high-throughput
cell washes for 3D cellular cultures with minimal cell loss or damage and highly effective
background removal.
][48]
[

#### flow cytometry sample prep

][49][Automate flow cytometry sample prep with all spindown, washing and reagent addition
steps using our
SLAS2024 New Product Award winning Blue®Plate and Blue®CombiX instrument.][50]
[

#### high throughput screening

][51][Our Blue®Washers are improving data quality in drug discovery within automated high throughput
screening cells all over the world.][52]
[

#### Magnetic Bead Assays

][53][With a suite of magnetic carriers, our Blue®Washer, Blue®Washer XL and Blue®CatX
platform significantly reduce run time and tip waste for magnetic bead assays such as NGS library
preparation, DNA extraction, and multiplex protein assays. ][54]
[

#### Genomics - NGS Assays

][55][Centrifugal Bead Separation (CBS) dramatically reduces tip cost and speeds up workflows such
as AMPure® magnetic bead clean-up for NGS library construction.][56]
[

#### centrifugation

][57][Our Blue®FugeX is an automation friendly centrifuge featuring high acceleration, high
tolerance for
imbalance, tall door to load sandwich plates and precise
settlement into well centers matching much larger centrifuges.
][58]
[

#### Plate Coating

][59][Blue®Bench is the perfect set up for poly-L-lysine, fibronectin, collagen and ELISA coating
protocols, particularly in 1536 well format as a walk away workflow - plates ready to use.
][60]

# customizable specialty lab services

Empowering our partners with advanced technologies and transformative solutions

EXPLORE AN OVERVIEW OF CELLEQORE PRODUCTS AND SERVICES

1) [Flow Cytometry Panel Design and Execution Services][30]
2) [Therapeutic Model Selection and Screening Using Flow Cytometry Services][31]
3) [Oncology and Immunology Based Assays][32]
4) [Data Analysis and Reports][33]

5) Flow Cytometry Training and Remote Support

### ENGAGE EMERGING CHALLENGES WITH INNOVATION

Celleqore uses transformative strategies and advanced technologies to support your high impact
innovations. We customize aspects of each specialty lab service according to your needs, product
specifications, and indication of use. Whether you are screening targets or in clinical trials, we
are here to support you throughout each phase of the process.

###### Flow Cytometry

Efficiently survey treatment impact using Celleqore’s flow cytometry platform instead of pouring
hundreds of thousands of dollars into *in vivo *studies. Choose from several of our flow cytometry
based assays

[DISCOVER more][34]

###### Cell-based assays

Preclinical developmental studies are critical activities that guide downstream decision-making
processes. Narrow down your *in vivo* drug efficacy model decisions by utilizing our *in vitro and
ex vivo *models.

[DISCOVER more][35]

###### Data analysis and training

Need your staff trained to perform flow cytometry? Need on-site sample acquisition? Have flow
cytometry data to be analyze, review, or interpret? We’ll take on those cumbersome tasks on your
behalf.

[DISCOVER more][36]

### LEARN MORE ABOUT [THE CYTEK AURORA][37] REVOLUTIONIZING FLOW CYTOMETRY

### Reimagine CRO partnerships

Our team of experienced scientists and researchers are dedicated to providing personalized support,
frequent correspondence, and informative guidance throughout the entire research journey. Whether
you require assistance in study design, sample acquisition, or data analysis, we are here to ensure
that you have access to the expertise and resources imperative for success.

### Celleqore empowers our partners with valuable insights into the intricate workings of the immune
### system and cellular interactions. This comprehensive understanding of cellular behavior can help
### accelerate the drug development process and create pathways where your treatment will be
### successful.

We provide strategic solutions and tailored services specifically to the needs of our partners. Our
main service revolves around next-generation flow cytometry, a cutting-edge technology that enables
simultaneous evaluation of 40 markers from multiple cell types or in-depth assessment on a single
cell type of interest.

[about us][38]

### CRO partnership ratings

We’ve been on the customer end of CRO partnerships. We know the frustrations experienced when
dealing with CROs and institutions. Celleqore is structured to be different.

##### Fast Response Times

We respond within 24h and no later than 48h. Everyone should be treated like their project is #1
priority.

##### Open Communication

Staying connected to study updates allows for efficient decision making and course correction. We
take extra measures to guarantee you know how your project is progressing.

##### Transparency

Trust is built through respect, transparency, and accountability. Along with the good, we will
report the bad and offer advice to improve outcomes.

##### Quick results Turnaround

No one wants to wait 4-8 weeks for results. Whether it’s preliminary results or finalized reports,
we provide fast turnaround of results.

##### Current Technology

Keeping up-to-date with the latest instrumentation and technology is expensive. Where does your CRO
partner invest most of its earnings? We reinvest our earnings into improving instrumentation,
advanced technology, and recruiting expert personnel.

##### Flexibility

We understand project targets change during a study. We work with you to make necessary adjustments
that your study needs.

pharmaceutical companies][40]

special discounts on our products and se

### ENGAGE EMERGING CHALLENGES WITH INNOVATION

Celleqore uses transformative strategies and advanced technologies to support your high impact
innovations. We customize aspects of each specialty lab service according to your needs, product
specifications, and indication of use. Whether you are screening targets or in clinical trials, we
are here to support you throughout each phase of the process.

###### Flow Cytometry

Efficiently survey treatment impact using Celleqore’s flow cytometry platform instead of pouring
hundreds of thousands of dollars into *in vivo *studies. Choose from several of our flow cytometry
based assays

[DISCOVER more][34]

###### Cell-based assays

Preclinical developmental studies are critical activities that guide downstream decision-making
processes. Narrow down your *in vivo* drug efficacy model decisions by utilizing our *in vitro and
ex vivo *models.

[DISCOVER more][35]

###### Data analysis and training

Need your staff trained to perform flow cytometry? Need on-site sample acquisition? Have flow
cytometry data to be analyze, review, or interpret? We’ll take on those cumbersome tasks on your
behalf.

[DISCOVER more][36]

### LEARN MORE ABOUT [THE CYTEK AURORA][37] REVOLUTIONIZING FLOW CYTOMETRY

### Reimagine CRO partnerships

Our team of experienced scientists and researchers are dedicated to providing personalized support,
frequent correspondence, and informative guidance throughout the entire research journey. Whether
you require assistance in study design, sample acquisition, or data analysis, we are here to ensure
that you have access to the expertise and resources imperative for success.

### Celleqore empowers our partners with valuable insights into the intricate workings of the immune
### system and cellular interactions. This comprehensive understanding of cellular behavior can help
### accelerate the drug development process and create pathways where your treatment will be
### successful.

We provide strategic solutions and tailored services specifically to the needs of our partners. Our
main service revolves around next-generation flow cytometry, a cutting-edge technology that enables
simultaneous evaluation of 40 markers from multiple cell types or in-depth assessment on a single
cell type of interest.

[about us][38]

### CRO partnership ratings

We’ve been on the customer end of CRO partnerships. We know the frustrations experienced when
dealing with CROs and institutions. Celleqore is structured to be different.

##### Fast Response Times

We respond within 24h and no later than 48h. Everyone should be treated like their project is #1
priority.

##### Open Communication

Staying connected to study updates allows for efficient decision making and course correction. We
take extra measures to guarantee you know how your project is progressing.

##### Transparency

Trust is built through respect, transparency, and accountability. Along with the good, we will
report the bad and offer advice to improve outcomes.

##### Quick results Turnaround

No one wants to wait 4-8 weeks for results. Whether it’s preliminary results or finalized reports,
we provide fast turnaround of results.

##### Current Technology

Keeping up-to-date with the latest instrumentation and technology is expensive. Where does your CRO
partner invest most of its earnings? We reinvest our earnings into improving instrumentation,
advanced technology, and recruiting expert personnel.

##### Flexibility

We understand project targets change during a study. We work with you to make necessary adjustments
that your study needs.

## Automation without Centrifugation

### Controlled Flow. Defined Washing. No Centrifuge.

Curiox replaces centrifugation with software-defined, pipette-based washing, bringing controlled
flow and repeatable wash conditions directly into automated workflows.
* Washing is defined by **software-controlled flow rates**
* Samples experience **gentle, low-shear liquid exchange**
* Wash conditions are **repeatable and consistent across runs**
* Automation remains **fully on-deck and uninterrupted**

## C-FREE™ Technology

The Pluto product family translates C‑FREE technology into deployable tools for labs at different
stages of automation adoption—whether that means a compact wash station, full workstation for cell
preparation, or software for your existing platforms.

## Automation without Centrifugation

### Controlled Flow. Defined Washing. No Centrifuge.

Curiox replaces centrifugation with software-defined, pipette-based washing, bringing controlled
flow and repeatable wash conditions directly into automated workflows.
* Washing is defined by **software-controlled flow rates**
* Samples experience **gentle, low-shear liquid exchange**
* Wash conditions are **repeatable and consistent across runs**
* Automation remains **fully on-deck and uninterrupted**

## C-FREE™ Technology

** Replace centrifugation with pipette-based flow **

[ Learn How C-FREE Works ][50]

## C-FREE™ Pluto Products

The Pluto product family translates C‑FREE technology into deployable tools for labs at different
stages of automation adoption—whether that means a compact wash station, full workstation for cell
preparation, or software for your existing platforms.

[Pluto ALPHA - Automated Cell Washing]

### Pluto ALPHA

Compact liquid handler for cell washing in a biosafety cabinet

[Pluto Workstation - Automated Antibody Cocktailing and Cell Staining]

### Pluto Workstation

Automated liquid handler for antibody cocktailing, cell staining, and washing

[Pluto Code]

### Pluto Code

Software library bringing C-FREE directly to your liquid handler

[ Browse All Products ][51]

## Pluto Code Data on Centrifuge-Free Workflows

**Centrifuge-free washing using Pluto Code. Executed directly on standard liquid handling platforms
without off-board centrifugation.**

### SLAS 2026 Scientific Poster
* Centrifuge-free washing via a script library within native liquid handler methods
* Comparable or improved cell retention across staining workflows
* Portability  across Opentrons and Hamilton platforms

[ Download the Poster ][53]

The Pluto Workstation automates antibody master mix preparation so panels are generated with robotic
precision. Cocktailing, staining, and downstream centrifuge-free washing can all be performed on a
single workstation, simplifying setup and reducing fragmented manual steps.

* Liquid-level detection
* Consistent cell preparation
* High-parameter antibody panels
* Low dead volumes
* Easy, SOP-like interface
* Audit trail and traceability

### Full Spectrum Innovation, Without Compromise


Introducing the Cytek Borealis^{™} system, the next-generation flow cytometer engineered to
accelerate discovery and unlock deeper biological insights. Built on proven FSP^{®} technology, it
doesn't just push boundaries, it eliminates them.
[ Learn More ][101]

### Cy’s Spectacular Summer


Cy, the Cytek unicorn, is sharing his love for the summer season by adding a free gift to your next
reagent order! Conditions apply.
[ Learn More ][102]

### Where Inspiration Leads To Discovery


From bold ideas to meaningful breakthroughs, Cytek solutions
support you in your journey!
[ Get Started ][103]

### Introducing The New Cytek^{®} cFluor^{®} Resource Center


Simplify your fluorochrome search with the new Cytek cFluor Resource Center, a centralized hub with
the technical details you need to make informed decisions during panel design.
[ Learn More ][104]

### TIME Recognizes Cytek^{®} Biosciences As One Of America’s Growth Leaders Of 2026


[ Learn More ][105]

### Cytek^{®} Muse^{®} Micro Cell Analyzer Wins Award For Drug Discovery Solution Of The Year


[ Learn More ][106]

### Evolving With Your Research Needs


Innovation built on a proven technology. Introducing the Cytek Aurora^{™} Evo system, setting the
new standard for full spectrum flow cytometry!
[ Learn More ][107]

## Latest News

### Cytek^{®} Biosciences Opens New Innovation Center in Bellevue to Advance R&D and Customer
### Engagement

[Learn More][108]

### Cytek^{®} Biosciences to Unveil Next-Generation Spectral Flow Cytometry Innovations at CYTO 2026

[Learn More][109]

### Cytek^{®} Biosciences Celebrates One Year of Operations at Singapore Facility, Accelerating
### Growth and Regional Impact

[Learn More][110]

### TIME Recognizes Cytek^{®} Biosciences as One of America’s Growth Leaders of 2026

[Learn More][111]

## Product Features

### Run More Fluorochromes Together

Conventional flow cytometers have difficulty distinguishing fluorochromes with highly overlapping
peak emissions, severely limiting fluorochrome choice and multiplexing capability.

Using full spectrum flow cytometry, our systems detect the entire fluorochrome emission, allowing
researchers to run panels of up to 40 colors and beyond without sacrificing data resolution.

[Graph]

## Glean More Information from One Tube

By making bigger panels possible, spectral flow cytometry provides researchers more information from
one tube and reduces the amount of tubes needed in an assay.

This saves precious sample and reagent, reduces sample preparation and acquisition time, and reduces
operating costs, allowing labs to run more efficiently.

[Cytometry]

## Get Up and Running Faster

Acquiring more data per sample does not mean longer instrument or experiment setup times.

With FSP^{®} technology, gone is the need to check and swap optical filters depending on the assay.

[Spectrum]

## Accelerating Reagent Advances

Cytek’s unique way of measuring the entire emission spectrum for each fluorochrome has expanded the
possibilities for reagent development.

### Endless Possibilities for New Fluorochromes

While Cytek’s full spectrum flow cytometry provides researchers unprecedented flexibility for panel
design, it also provides new capabilities for evaluating fluorochromes and understanding their
impacts on one another when used in combination.

No longer limited by the conventional peak emission bandpass filter paradigm, researchers can now
visualize the full spectrum characteristics of each fluorochrome across each laser line and look for
new spectrally unique reagents to integrate into continuously expanding panel designs.

[Fluorochromes]

### cFluor^{®} Reagents, Optimized for Spectral Cytometry

Cytek’s experience in designing highly multiparametric panels has led to a deeper understanding of
how fluorochromes react together in increasingly complex fluorescent experiments. Using this
expertise, Cytek developed and launched the new cFluor reagents, optimized for use in full spectrum
panels.

[Fluor]

## Cytek Solutions

With an increasing number of parameters to analyze with a dearth of analytical solutions, Cytek
provides a plethora of tools and solutions to efficiently complete the path from experiment design
to high-quality interpretable results.

### Powerful Tools and Expert Applications Support

Cytek has developed a variety of tools to help researchers develop panels while ensuring ease of
use. For example, the [ Cytek Full Spectrum Viewer][112] and novel Similarity™ and Complexity™
Indices provide quantitative feedback to help researchers make smarter fluorochrome choices in their
multicolor applications.

Combining these tools with Cytek’s knowledgeable and experienced team of technical application
specialists leads to more successful experiments with deeper scientific insights.

[Applications] [Applications]

### Software Partners

Cytek understands that software is important to analyzing the large datasets typically generated by
the Aurora or any other flow cytometer. Therefore, we have partnered with a variety of innovative
software leaders to develop streamlined workflows for Aurora and Northern Lights.

## Product Features

### Run More Fluorochromes Together

Conventional flow cytometers have difficulty distinguishing fluorochromes with highly overlapping
peak emissions, severely limiting fluorochrome choice and multiplexing capability.

Using full spectrum flow cytometry, our systems detect the entire fluorochrome emission, allowing
researchers to run panels of up to 40 colors and beyond without sacrificing data resolution.

[Graph]

## Glean More Information from One Tube

By making bigger panels possible, spectral flow cytometry provides researchers more information from
one tube and reduces the amount of tubes needed in an assay.

This saves precious sample and reagent, reduces sample preparation and acquisition time, and reduces
operating costs, allowing labs to run more efficiently.

[Cytometry]

## Get Up and Running Faster

Acquiring more data per sample does not mean longer instrument or experiment setup times.

With FSP^{®} technology, gone is the need to check and swap optical filters depending on the assay.

[Spectrum]

## Accelerating Reagent Advances

Cytek’s unique way of measuring the entire emission spectrum for each fluorochrome has expanded the
possibilities for reagent development.

### Endless Possibilities for New Fluorochromes

While Cytek’s full spectrum flow cytometry provides researchers unprecedented flexibility for panel
design, it also provides new capabilities for evaluating fluorochromes and understanding their
impacts on one another when used in combination.

No longer limited by the conventional peak emission bandpass filter paradigm, researchers can now
visualize the full spectrum characteristics of each fluorochrome across each laser line and look for
new spectrally unique reagents to integrate into continuously expanding panel designs.

[Fluorochromes]

### cFluor^{®} Reagents, Optimized for Spectral Cytometry

Cytek’s experience in designing highly multiparametric panels has led to a deeper understanding of
how fluorochromes react together in increasingly complex fluorescent experiments. Using this
expertise, Cytek developed and launched the new cFluor reagents, optimized for use in full spectrum
panels.

[Fluor]

## Cytek Solutions

With an increasing number of parameters to analyze with a dearth of analytical solutions, Cytek
provides a plethora of tools and solutions to efficiently complete the path from experiment design
to high-quality interpretable results.

### Powerful Tools and Expert Applications Support

Cytek has developed a variety of tools to help researchers develop panels while ensuring ease of
use. For example, the [ Cytek Full Spectrum Viewer][112] and novel Similarity™ and Complexity™
Indices provide quantitative feedback to help researchers make smarter fluorochrome choices in their
multicolor applications.

Combining these tools with Cytek’s knowledgeable and experienced team of technical application
specialists leads to more successful experiments with deeper scientific insights.

[Applications] [Applications]

### Software Partners

Cytek understands that software is important to analyzing the large datasets typically generated by
the Aurora or any other flow cytometer. Therefore, we have partnered with a variety of innovative
software leaders to develop streamlined workflows for Aurora and Northern Lights.

# Flow cytometry analysis, evolved for the modern web.

A fast, browser-based workspace for your daily flow cytometry. No expensive licenses, no
installation, and no friction—just the tools you need to see your data.

[Start Analysis →][5] [Old Version][6]
[App Workspace Mockup]

## Engineered to be light, agile, and immediate.

### 100% Client-Side Processing

Your research data never leaves your computer. All rendering, mathematical operations, and
population gating calculations are executed locally in real-time on your device.

### Data Privacy

We don't store, view, or upload your research. Your proprietary files stay entirely on your local
machine, giving you complete ownership of your data environment.

### Accessible Science

Built for the community. We believe every student and researcher should have quality tools at their
fingertips, regardless of budget.

Our comprehensive Flow Cytometry solutions include advanced, unique products, automated sample
preparation, flow cytometers, filters, reagents, monoclonal antibodies and analytical software.
Unless otherwise indicated, all flow cytometry products available in this website are for Research
Use Only.


[ Request Info ][102]
[Flow]

[ Order Now ][103]
* [Sample preparation]
  
  ### Instruments
  
  Explore advanced flow cytometry instruments to help you manage workflow and data analysis.
  [ Explore ][104]
* [flow]
  
  ### Reagents
  
  Discover how our CyFlow antibody portfolio (ASRs) contribute to your core clinical Laboratory
  developed tests (LDTs) and how our more than 1000 RUO  reagents support laboratory requirements
  ranging from the routine to the most niche testing.  
  [ Explore ][105]
* [DNA]
  
  ### Applications
  
  Discover how flow cytometry DNA analysis is applied in agriculture and aquaculture, and
  microbiology in beverages and water.
  
  [ Explore ][106]
* [Consumables ]
  
  ### Consumables
  
  Discover how our consumables including filters, calibration and QC particles, cleaning fluid and
  vials help labs prepare samples for cell culture or measurement by flow cytometry.
  [ Explore ][107]
I am really happy with the Sysmex flow cytometry antibodies. Transitioning to Sysmex was a smart
move. Thank you.
Carisa Crumpler, MT, (ASCP), Lab Manager
Since we started using Sysmex's PS-10 Sample Preparation System, the workflow has been smooth,
effective and precise. PS-10 produces a detailed report of every step of the process for
documentation, which gives me peace of mind. Worklists are produced via barcodes and can be
transferred to the flow cytometer, reducing processing time. Most of all, it uses reagents with
minimal dead volume remaining, making PS-10 very cost-effective for our lab. I have high regard for
Sysmex's PS-10.
Dimi K., MS, Lab Manager, Omega Molecular Laboratories

## Discover more in flow cytometry
* [Flow Cytometry 101: Fluids+Cells+Measurements]
  
  ### Flow Cytometry 101: Fluids Cells Measurements
  
  During this webinar, the presenter will discuss the theory and principles of flow technology and
  how it has evolved over the last few decades. Case-based review will be used to highlight the
  diagnostic advantages of flow cytometry testing.
  
  [ Learn More ][108]
* [ps-10]
  
  ### White Paper | Time Savings with the Sysmex PS-10™ Sample Preparation System
  
  The PS-10 is designed to automate and streamline time-consuming manual tasks in today's busy
  clinical flow cytometry laboratories. Laboratories can significantly improve efficiency and
  productivity by reducing the hands-on time spent on repetitive, labor-intensive processes.
  
  [ Learn More ][109]

## Explore more lab solutions
* [UN 3000 product image]
  
  ### Urinalysis
  
  Explore our urinalysis solutions designed to provide your lab with start-to-finish urinalysis
  workflow, maximum flexibility and minimal hands-on time.
  
  [ Explore ][110]
* [XN-Series Analyzers]
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Our award-winning hematology analyzers are scalable, modular and customized for your laboratory’s
  needs.
  
  [ Explore ][111]
* [Blood cells]
  
  ### Hemostasis
  
  Accurately and precisely measure the factors required to stop bleeding and identify possible
  abnormalities.
  
  [ Explore Hemostasis ][112]

## THE CENTRE FOR IMMUNE ANALYTICS

The University of Toronto’s Centre for Immune Analytics offers a broad range of services for
research in biology. Our facility is located in the Medical Sciences Building next to Queen’s Park,
a central and convenient location for users across the Greater Toronto Area.

[ Book our instruments ][11]

## Registration & Services

Individuals and parties interested in access to the Centre for Immune Analytics must first register
and undergo training. For registration, hourly rates, and terms of usages, please consult the
following pages.
 
[ Learn more about our Registration & Services ][12]

## FLOW CYTOMETRY

The University of Toronto’s Flow Cytometry Facility offers state-of-the-art analytical and
high-speed cell sorting services to both academic and corporate clients.


## Instruments

Our flow facility is comprised of six state-of-the-art analyzers and three sorters from Becton
Dickinson. Two instruments are spectrally enhanced for more complex user experiments.

[ Learn more about our flow instruments ][13]

## Learn More About Flow Cytometry

## Intro to Flow

[ Learn more ][14]

## Applications

[ Learn more ][15]

## Protocols

[ Learn more ][16]

## Resources

[ Learn more ][17]

## MASS CYTOMETRY *NEW*

The new Mass Cytometry facility offers services on the upgraded CYTOF XT and Hyperion XTi
instruments from Standard BioTools.

## CYTOF XT - Suspension

Imagine the principles of flow cytometry but using metal-tagged antibodies to expand analytes
without the burden of additional compensation. Fully automated.

## HYPERION XTi - Imaging

Introducing new groundbreaking capabilities for multiplexed tissue imaging at never-before-seen
speeds and automation. The Hyperion™ XTi Imaging System is now available with **three imaging
modes** for rapid and detailed analysis.

[ Learn more ][18]

## SINGLE CELL TRANSCRIPTOMICS *NEW*

Our new sequencing facility offers library preparation services for single-cell and spatial
transcriptomics.

## Single-cell sequencing

We offer consultation and library preparation services using 10x Genomics GEM-X chemistry, as well
as custom alignment and downstream data analysis.

## Spatial transcriptomics

Bring us your frozen or FFPE samples for spatial transcriptomics using the Visium CytAssist.

[ Learn more ][19]

## LIVE CELL IMAGING *NEW*

Automate your live cell imaging using the Sartorius Incucyte SX5.



[ Sartorius Incucyte SX5 ][20]

# FlowKnowHow LLC

At FlowKnowHow we pride ourselves in helping our clients succeed in their research endeavors. We
provide customized flow cytometry solutions and are looking forward to working with you to achieve
your goals.

[Get in Touch][9]
[FKH InfoGraphicShortCropped2 2018-12-21.]
Home: Project

## About Us

[YM 2016.png]

### FlowKnowHow LLC was founded in 2018 by Yolanda Mahnke, PhD, an internationally recognized expert
### in the field of flow cytometry. After obtaining a bachelor in biology from Imperial College of
### Science, Technology and Medicine, she performed her graduate work at the German Cancer Research
### Center (DKFZ) and obtained a PhD in tumor immunology from The Open University. She then worked
### in tumor and infection immunology at the Lausanne Branch of the Ludwig Institute for Cancer
### Research, NIH's Vaccine Research Center, and the University of Pennsylvania, before becoming a
### freelance flow cytometry consultant. During her research career she published seminal concepts
### that have become mainstream ideas in flow cytometry techniques. To access relevant publications,
### [click here][10].


A major contribution was the co-development of a novel publication platform in Cytometry Part A,
called Optimized Multicolor Immunofluorescence Panels, or OMIPs for short, that allowed to publish
and receive credit for the development of highly optimized reagent panels for flow cytometry and
fluorescence imaging. For this and other achievements in the field she was awarded a prestigious
IMISP scholarship from the International Society for the Advancement of Cytometry (ISAC). She is an
active member of ISAC, serving on some of ISAC's committees, the Senior Associate Editor for Cancer
Immunology and OMIPs for Cytometry Part A, and a Scientific Advisor for FluoroFinder.


At FlowKnowHow, we build on this track record of scientific excellence to provide our clients
services of the highest professional standards.

[Get in Touch][11]
Home: Inner_about

## FlowKnowHow LLC Services

[consulting.png]

### Introductory Consultation

We provide customized consulting services in flow cytometry and associated topics. In a
complementary introductory consultation we assess your project details and flow cytometry needs in
order to develop a personalized working plan that will allow you to achieve quality results. Get in
touch to learn more about how we can help you.

[assay development.png]

### Panel design and assay development

Looking to use flow cytometry for immuno-monitoring in a clinical study, but not sure where to
begin? Need help planning or developing your next flow cytometry project? Let us guide you. From
selecting relevant markers, designing putative panels, and identifying potential reagents, to
providing an assay validation and qualification strategy, we will guide you through essential panel
and assay development steps.

[data analysis.png]

### Data analysis, interpretation and reporting

FlowKnowHow provides blinded data analysis services in order to remove any potential bias. All
gating trees are documented in detail to simplify knowledge transfer. We will apply scientific rigor
to interpret your data and prepare comprehensive reports. If you need assistance integrating flow
cytometry results into official documents such as publications, study reports or grant applications,
please get in touch.

[education.png]

### Education

Whether your team is inexperienced or well-versed in standard flow techniques, there is always
something new to learn in the ever-evolving field of flow cytometry. At FlowKnowHow, we believe that
an increased understanding of this technique's component parts leads to improved data. Our focus is
on multi-parametric flow cytometry panels, and associated troubleshooting and techniques. We’re
happy to adapt any on-site training module to your specific needs.

[expert review.png]

### Expert review

Even with in-house flow cytometry experts it can be invaluable to obtain an independent assessment
of technical and analytical approaches. We will review your protocols, study outlines and data
analyses, as well as providing expert feedback on your presentation slides to make sure your data
are accurately and evocatively represented. At FlowKnowHow, we use our skills and expertise to make
your research shine.

## About Us

[YM 2016.png]

### FlowKnowHow LLC was founded in 2018 by Yolanda Mahnke, PhD, an internationally recognized expert
### in the field of flow cytometry. After obtaining a bachelor in biology from Imperial College of
### Science, Technology and Medicine, she performed her graduate work at the German Cancer Research
### Center (DKFZ) and obtained a PhD in tumor immunology from The Open University. She then worked
### in tumor and infection immunology at the Lausanne Branch of the Ludwig Institute for Cancer
### Research, NIH's Vaccine Research Center, and the University of Pennsylvania, before becoming a
### freelance flow cytometry consultant. During her research career she published seminal concepts
### that have become mainstream ideas in flow cytometry techniques. To access relevant publications,
### [click here][10].


A major contribution was the co-development of a novel publication platform in Cytometry Part A,
called Optimized Multicolor Immunofluorescence Panels, or OMIPs for short, that allowed to publish
and receive credit for the development of highly optimized reagent panels for flow cytometry and
fluorescence imaging. For this and other achievements in the field she was awarded a prestigious
IMISP scholarship from the International Society for the Advancement of Cytometry (ISAC). She is an
active member of ISAC, serving on some of ISAC's committees, the Senior Associate Editor for Cancer
Immunology and OMIPs for Cytometry Part A, and a Scientific Advisor for FluoroFinder.

services of the highest professional standards.

begin? Need help planning or developing your next flow cytometry project? Let us guide you. From

providing an assay validation and qualification strategy, we will guide you through essential panel

cytometry results into official documents such as publications, study reports or grant applications,
please get in touch.

### Welcome to “Flowcytometry Solutions”

Flowcytometry Solutions (FlowSols) is a flow cytometry consulting company, which aims at providing
complete solution to the researchers and clinicians on flow cytometry. FlowSols has started off as
an organization to provide the required support in the field of flow cytometry in India and
neighboring countries.Here, we offer to provide support to the students and researchers engrossed to
flow cytometry pitch, towards addressing problems pertaining to instrument handling, experiment
design and applications, sample preparation, acquisition, data investigation and presentation. Our
mission is to provide a complete flow cytometry expertise, which can help researchers to innovate,
lead and excel.

### Testmonials

Excellent workshop on flow cytometry, delivered by the experts. Being from the field of
Immuno-parasitology, attending this work was very pertinent to the field of my research. The
workshop included the basics concept on flow cytometry, along with the online practical session and
also included the most advanced technique currently being used in this field. Study material and
questionnaire at the end of the session for evaluating each participants have been really helpful.
The team is really very helpful and forthcoming. A very practical and relevant course for a
researcher.

Ms.Chinmayee, B. R. Research Student, Department of Zoology, S. P. Pune University, India

I feel very inspired and confident by the unique demonstration and analysis of Flow Cytometry data
by the experts from FlowSols. They generously explained the machine instrumentation as well as its
functionality aspects in a lucid manner. I have learnt how the analyses of cells cycle, apoptosis;
and proteins (cytokines/markers) profiling could be performed simply and accurately. Each learning
day with “FlowSols” has incredibly quenched my thirst on Flow Cytometry; the care and empowered
discussions from the Flow-experts have made me love this technique to a large extent.

Sachidananda Behera, Ph.D. Scholar, Dept. of Biochemistry, ICMR-RMRIMS, Patna

I've attended three of Dr. Hemant Agrawal's workshops. I had a great time and learned a lot. The
workshops were run with great efficiency, yet in that short amount of time, he managed to establish
a warm and genuine relationship with each student, making us feel at ease about airing out the
problems and assisting us in finding viable solutions. I'm grateful for what Dr. Hemant Agrawal
taught me. He is exactly what a teacher should be — thank you for the inspiration! I wholeheartedly
suggest Flowcytometry Solutions Pvt. Ltd's training programmes to anyone working in the flow
cytometry field, and I personally thank Dr. Hemant Agrawal for all of his assistance and guidance.

Ms. Payal Modi, FACS Operator, GBRC, Ahmedabad

I have attended many online flow cytometry courses during the last couple of years conducted by
different providers, but I have no doubt in saying that the courses conducted by Flowsols was par
excellence and unmatchable. The online courses were perfectly designed to incorporate up to date
scientific, technical and clinical component; and address the relevant needs of the participants.
These courses were delivered by some of the renowned local and international subject experts. There
was plenty of support and guidance available during the course and afterwards. The session
recordings were available on request and the study materials shared with each course provided an
additional wealth of knowledge to explore and learn. I also had a chance to interact personally with
Dr. Agarwal and his team, and I’m grateful for their guidance and support. Dr. Agrawal is gem of a
person and he has an unmatchable dedication and passion to share the knowledge of flow cytometry. I
have no doubt in strongly recommending Flowsols training programs, courses and workshops to anyone
interested in the field flow cytometry.

Dr. M. Adnan Qureshi, Consultant Hematopathologist, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

In 2020, I attended the flow cytometry workshop that was conducted by Dr. Agrawal and Flowcytometry
Solutions Team. It was a great workshop with interesting sections and I learned a lot. Dr. Agrawal
as a professional person in flow cytometry managed this workshop and created really powerful event.
During this workshop I found answer of many questions (in panel design, Data Analysis and different
aspects of flow cytometry). I suggest flow cytometry solution programs to someone who is interested
to learn more in flow cytometry. Finally I'm really thankful of Dr. Agrawal for his great training
and guidance.

Masoumeh Azimi, Flow Cytometry Lab assistant, Royan Institute, Trehan, Iran

It is always a great experience interacting and working with Flowcytometry Solutions (FlowSols).  We
are very happy about the flow cytometry hands-on workshops conducted by Venture Center and Flowsols
together and look forward to many such fruitful associations in future. The excellence in quality
and delivery of content and the approachable nature of Dr. Hemant Agrawal helps the participants
understand and deep dive in the subject during and after the training program. The depth of
knowledge in the field of flow cytometry Dr. Hemant brings with him, and the passion of sharing this
knowledge with the future generation of flow cytometrists, is simply unparalleled!

Sujaya Ingale, Head - Scientific Initiatives, Venture Center, Pune

The Flowcytometry Solutions is a good organization with a contemporary, innovative, entrepreneurial
and knowledge sharing approach that distinguishes it from other organisations. It has helped me
gaining the knowledge and diving in the sea of Flow Cytometry and grow professionally as well. Dr.
Hemant and his team members are very transparent and supportive to make understand the various
topics in this field by organising and selecting excellent faculties which delivers and clears our
doubts in very simple way using examples. I feel honoured being part of the events organized by Dr.
Hemant and his team.

Dr. Rina A. Prajapati, D. C. P, DNB (PATH), Consultant Pathologist, Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Want to learn how to use Flow Cytometry the right way? Need assistance with experimental design or
data analysis? Unsure what controls to use? Want to outsource your samples? Flowcytometry Solutions
is truly a one-stop, high-quality solution for anything related to Flow Cytometry.

Dr. Himanshu Tillu, Professional Flow Cytometrist, India

I have been connected with Dr. Hemant Agrawal at FlowSols for some time now and have found him to be
an excellent guide for flow cytometry. He is a recognized expert in this field and readily shares
his experience and knowledge. This sharing is enhanced and broadened via FlowSols, which is a great
resource for advancing one’s knowledge about flow cytometry and a platform for an enriching,
interactive, learning experience. I would wholeheartedly recommend this company and its team to
anyone who is interested in understanding flow cytometry from its very basics to the most advanced
levels

Dr. Seema Chhabra, MD, DNB, MNAMS, Asst. Professor, Department of Immunopathology, PGIMER,

# [Harness the Power of SPR Platform for Comprehensive Interactome Research][158]

Gain deep insights into molecular interactions with our advanced Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR)
technology. Explore protein-protein, protein-DNA, and protein-small molecule interactions with high
sensitivity and real-time analysis.

[ Explore SPR Platform ][159]

[Illuminate Protein Interactions with BioID][160]

Revolutionize your understanding of protein interaction networks using BioID, a proximity-based
labeling technique. Identify and analyze transient and stable protein associations within cells,
uncovering crucial insights into signaling pathways, protein complexes, and cellular processes.

[ Explore BioID Platform ][161]

[Uncover the Complexity of Molecular Interactions with HDX-MS][162]

Leverage the cutting-edge Hydrogen-Deuterium Exchange Mass Spectrometry (HDX-MS) technique to study
protein dynamics, conformational changes, and ligand binding events. Obtain valuable insights into
protein-protein interactions and structural analysis for drug discovery and development.

[ Explore HDX-MS Service ][163]

[Unravel the Intricacies of Protein-RNA Interactions][164]

Investigate the dynamic interplay between proteins and RNA molecules using our advanced analysis
tools. Explore RNA binding sites, functional domains, and regulatory mechanisms to understand gene
expression, RNA processing, and post-transcriptional regulation.

[ Explore Protein-RNA Interactions ][165]

[Unlock Molecular Insights with Our Docking Services][166]

Explore the hidden interactions between molecules through our advanced molecular docking services.
From revealing binding mechanisms to guiding drug optimization, our expertise opens new doors in
molecular simulation. Join us in shaping the future of scientific discovery.

[ Explore Molecular Docking ][167]

Creative Proteomics is the world's leading independent biotechnology company, and the
ultra-high-precision and comprehensive technology platforms we have established enable us to provide
high-quality services and solutions for scientists studying various molecular interactions around
the world.

Since the establishment of the company, we have provided testing, screening, verification,
development and other services to tens of thousands of scientists from different countries, and we
can also provide novel research directions according to their needs.

Creative Proteomics has a large number of PhD-level technicians and professional teams in various
fields, all of whom have more than 20 years of research experience in their respective fields. Our
advanced development concept and broad vision have created our systematic and all-round technology
platforms. On our platforms, you can do almost any research you are interested in.

Creative Proteomics is committed to the research and application of molecular interactions in
biology and other disciplines, to explore the mysteries of the microcosm with the highest standards.
Our ultimate goal is to provide high-satisfaction assistance to customers who have research needs in
molecular interaction and related fields, and save time, energy and money while providing perfect
data.

# [Harness the Power of SPR Platform for Comprehensive Interactome Research][158]

Gain deep insights into molecular interactions with our advanced Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR)
technology. Explore protein-protein, protein-DNA, and protein-small molecule interactions with high
sensitivity and real-time analysis.

[ Explore SPR Platform ][159]

[Illuminate Protein Interactions with BioID][160]

Revolutionize your understanding of protein interaction networks using BioID, a proximity-based
labeling technique. Identify and analyze transient and stable protein associations within cells,
uncovering crucial insights into signaling pathways, protein complexes, and cellular processes.

[ Explore BioID Platform ][161]

[Uncover the Complexity of Molecular Interactions with HDX-MS][162]

Leverage the cutting-edge Hydrogen-Deuterium Exchange Mass Spectrometry (HDX-MS) technique to study
protein dynamics, conformational changes, and ligand binding events. Obtain valuable insights into
protein-protein interactions and structural analysis for drug discovery and development.

[ Explore HDX-MS Service ][163]

[Unravel the Intricacies of Protein-RNA Interactions][164]

Investigate the dynamic interplay between proteins and RNA molecules using our advanced analysis
tools. Explore RNA binding sites, functional domains, and regulatory mechanisms to understand gene
expression, RNA processing, and post-transcriptional regulation.

[ Explore Protein-RNA Interactions ][165]

[Unlock Molecular Insights with Our Docking Services][166]

Explore the hidden interactions between molecules through our advanced molecular docking services.
From revealing binding mechanisms to guiding drug optimization, our expertise opens new doors in
molecular simulation. Join us in shaping the future of scientific discovery.

[ Explore Molecular Docking ][167]

## CAR-T cells:

High resolution recognition and discrimination with a single reagent by **flow cytometry.**

[Read more][181]

## TCRBC1/TCRBC2
## double-labeling:

Accuracy in the identification of
T neoplasms by **flow cytometry.**

[More info][182]

## Fluorescent dextrans:

An alternative to classical fluorescent labelling methods for **flow cytometry.**

Better signal and greater versatility.

[Read more][183]

## Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria:

PNH results from the loss of GPI-anchored proteins, leading to complement-mediated destruction of
blood cells that can be accurately detected by high-sensitivity flow cytometry.

[Leer más][184]

22SBV6102-100T CD22(S-HLC-1) StarBright™ UltraViolet 610 | RUO | 100 test

At Immunostep we have been** innovating since 2001 **to develop comprehensive products related to
**Flow Cytometry** that contribute to improve performance in key areas of clinical **Research and
Diagnostic** development. Our goal is to improve performance by innovating and adapting new
technology to collaborate building meaningful clinical investigation. 

# **Flow Cytometry solutions for **

# **fast, sensitive and ****non-invasive diagnostics**

Leading-edge products that will improve your results.

Research, Development and Innovation (R&D&i) extensive programme.

Seeking efficency and offering alternatives to traditional solutions.

Succesful technology licensing and meaningful worldwide collaborations.

# **Research and Diagnostic solutions since 2001
# **

As a** leading provider **of technologies, tools, and services **for bioscience and
biopharmaceutical manufacturing, **we offer a wide range of assays, kits and solutions for **Flow
Cytometry**.

[ Find out More ][196]

### **Unlocking the Potential of Exosomes**

In 2017 Immunostep R&D team recognized the **great potential of exosomes** and since then we have
been working on the development of a method for detecting, isolating and quantifying extracellular
vesicles which are present in fluid samples.  

[ Find out More ][197]

# **Improving SARS-CoV-2 Serology Testing Performance**

As a response to SARs-CoV-2 global emergency we developed a product line in order to** improve
serological testing performance** and help building clinical investigation around Covid-19 disease. 

[ Find out More ][198]

We find the most innovative technology and use them to build adaptative clinical products to
diagnose and treat diseases, and we work to achieve our goals **under a strict system of values**:

[Unceasing Innovation][199]

We seek always to be at the **leading-edge of technology** in research areas of development, and in
order to achieve that goal, we work under an **extensive R&D program** headed by a brilliant team of
Flow Cytometry experts.

[Science and Technology support][200]

Immunostep strongly supports the renewal of investment in science and technology to **support the
development of the scientific community** and its research efforts on a global scale.

[Highest Quality standards][201]

Intensifying our commitment to offer **high quality products**, Immunostep works under an **ISO
13485: 2018 Certified Quality Management System**, which complies with international standards for
the manufacture of medical devices and reagents.

[Social and Environmental commitment][202]

The social well-being of our employees, suppliers and local communities is among our objectives as a
**socially responsible company**. We assess the environmental and social impact of all the projects
in which we invest and collaborate with our customers to reach international best practice
agreements.

## double-labeling:

## Fluorescent dextrans:

An alternative to classical fluorescent labelling methods for **flow cytometry.**

Better signal and greater versatility.

[Read more][183]

## Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria:

PNH results from the loss of GPI-anchored proteins, leading to complement-mediated destruction of
blood cells that can be accurately detected by high-sensitivity flow cytometry.

Diagnostic** development. Our goal is to improve performance by innovating and adapting new
technology to collaborate building meaningful clinical investigation.

As a** leading provider **of technologies, tools, and services **for bioscience and
biopharmaceutical manufacturing, **we offer a wide range of assays, kits and solutions for **Flow
Cytometry**.

[ Find out More ][196]

### **Unlocking the Potential of Exosomes**

In 2017 Immunostep R&D team recognized the **great potential of exosomes** and since then we have
been working on the development of a method for detecting, isolating and quantifying extracellular
vesicles which are present in fluid samples.  

[ Find out More ][197]

# **Improving SARS-CoV-2 Serology Testing Performance**

As a response to SARs-CoV-2 global emergency we developed a product line in order to** improve
serological testing performance** and help building clinical investigation around Covid-19 disease. 

[ Find out More ][198]

We find the most innovative technology and use them to build adaptative clinical products to
diagnose and treat diseases, and we work to achieve our goals **under a strict system of values**:

[Unceasing Innovation][199]

We seek always to be at the **leading-edge of technology** in research areas of development, and in
order to achieve that goal, we work under an **extensive R&D program** headed by a brilliant team of
Flow Cytometry experts.

[Science and Technology support][200]

Immunostep strongly supports the renewal of investment in science and technology to **support the
development of the scientific community** and its research efforts on a global scale.

[Highest Quality standards][201]

Intensifying our commitment to offer **high quality products**, Immunostep works under an **ISO
13485: 2018 Certified Quality Management System**, which complies with international standards for
the manufacture of medical devices and reagents.

[Social and Environmental commitment][202]

The social well-being of our employees, suppliers and local communities is among our objectives as a
**socially responsible company**. We assess the environmental and social impact of all the projects
in which we invest and collaborate with our customers to reach international best practice
agreements.

# Bioanalytical CRO Excellence

Welcome to KCAS Bio, your global bioanalytical CRO partner with the expertise, capacity and
flexibility sponsors require.

[
How can we help?
][150]

### CRO for preclinical and clinical bioanalysis

KCAS Bio is a leading bioanalytical contract research organization (CRO) with a proven record of
advancing drug development worldwide. We have provided bioanalytical development support for more
than 315 approved drugs on the market, developed over 6,200 proprietary and non-proprietary assays,
and successfully completed more than 20 FDA audits with no major findings.

As a top bioanalytical CRO lab, we continually invest in the latest instrumentation and combine this
technical expertise with a consultative approach, ensuring our clients’ goals are achieved with
confidence. Our teams also bring specialized expertise in advanced modalities, allowing us to
support the evolving needs of modern drug development. By consistently benchmarking and optimizing
our operations, we help scientific innovators and investors move forward with greater certainty.

With lab facilities across the US and Europe, along with a strategic alliance in Australia, we
provide global sponsors with comprehensive services including bioanalytical, biomarker,
immunogenicity, cellular and molecular assay capabilities, as well as clinical kitting and sample
management.

Did you Know? We have Harmonized Spectral Flow Cytometry on a Global Scale!

KCAS Bio is the only bioanalytical laboratory with globally harmonized Cytek spectral flow
cytometers, with sites in the US, EU and Australia.

[
More on Global Spectral Flow Cytometry
][151]

[5000 Proprietary and Non Proprietary Assays Developed to Date.][65 PhDs on Staff][25 FDA Audits][45
Years in Service][4 World Wide Locations]

### Global biomarker and bioanalytical CRO lab

KCAS Bio is an established bioanalytical CRO with over 45 years of experience. We understand the
human and financial impact of drug development delays. Through our unique approach to capacity
planning, we combine the right experts with the right instrumentation to keep development moving
smoothly. Our clients consider us a reliable partner because we strive to minimize downtime, avoid
delays, and keep lead times as short as possible.

Explore all our solutions
][152]

# Bioanalytical CRO Excellence

Welcome to KCAS Bio, your global bioanalytical CRO partner with the expertise, capacity and
flexibility sponsors require.

[
How can we help?
][150]

### CRO for preclinical and clinical bioanalysis

KCAS Bio is a leading bioanalytical contract research organization (CRO) with a proven record of
advancing drug development worldwide. We have provided bioanalytical development support for more
than 315 approved drugs on the market, developed over 6,200 proprietary and non-proprietary assays,
and successfully completed more than 20 FDA audits with no major findings.

As a top bioanalytical CRO lab, we continually invest in the latest instrumentation and combine this
technical expertise with a consultative approach, ensuring our clients’ goals are achieved with
confidence. Our teams also bring specialized expertise in advanced modalities, allowing us to
support the evolving needs of modern drug development. By consistently benchmarking and optimizing
our operations, we help scientific innovators and investors move forward with greater certainty.

With lab facilities across the US and Europe, along with a strategic alliance in Australia, we
provide global sponsors with comprehensive services including bioanalytical, biomarker,
immunogenicity, cellular and molecular assay capabilities, as well as clinical kitting and sample
management.

Did you Know? We have Harmonized Spectral Flow Cytometry on a Global Scale!

KCAS Bio is the only bioanalytical laboratory with globally harmonized Cytek spectral flow
cytometers, with sites in the US, EU and Australia.

[
More on Global Spectral Flow Cytometry
][151]

[5000 Proprietary and Non Proprietary Assays Developed to Date.][65 PhDs on Staff][25 FDA Audits][45
Years in Service][4 World Wide Locations]

### Global biomarker and bioanalytical CRO lab

KCAS Bio is an established bioanalytical CRO with over 45 years of experience. We understand the
human and financial impact of drug development delays. Through our unique approach to capacity
planning, we combine the right experts with the right instrumentation to keep development moving
smoothly. Our clients consider us a reliable partner because we strive to minimize downtime, avoid
delays, and keep lead times as short as possible.

# Your Total Laboratory Solution Provider for Life, Food, Material & Pharmaceutical Science

DKSH offers specialized analytical equipment and services in the fields of chemical analysis and
material sciences. The main market sectors we serve include the environmental, food, dairy,
beverage, pharmaceutical and petrochemical industries, mining and minerals, as well as wine
laboratories. We provide application, after-sales support, as well as end-user training. We serve
commercial testing and manufacturing laboratories, as well as research institutions and
universities.

The Wonder of Living Light

## The World’s First Naturally Glowing Plants

Light Bio brings the hidden wonders of the world into your hands with the world’s first naturally
glowing plants! Inspired by the bioluminescence found in our oceans and forests, these extraordinary
plants glow with their own living energy. No batteries, wires, or sprays.

Light Bio’s bioluminescent petunias offer a new way to witness the vitality of nature! During the
day, our petunias harvest and store energy through photosynthesis. At night, the plants convert that
stored energy into a visible soft, steady glow that permeates the entire plant, from its brightest
new blooms to every leaf and stem.

[Before Image]
[After Image]

## The Magic is Resting Until Spring 2027 

Our 2026 season has officially come to a close. While our bioluminescent plants are back in the
greenhouse, the wonder doesn't stop here.

Become a Glow-Getter to receive our newsletters and join the waitlist! We'll be sharing glowing
stories, plant care tips, exclusive behind-the-scenes looks at our biotech greenhouse, and official
updates on our Spring 2027 return.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Here are some quick answers about Light Bio’s bioluminescent petunias. Need more details? Explore
FAQs or contact us anytime.

[Contact Us][36] [ View All FAQs ][37]

### What is the difference between Bioluminescence and Fluorescence?

The difference lies in the **source of the energy**: Bioluminescence (internal) **is** light created
by a chemical reaction within the organism. Like a firefly, our plants use their own metabolism to
glow 24/7, requiring no external "charging" or blacklights. Fluorescence (external) is light
absorbed from an outside source (like UV light) and reflected back. Without a constant external
light source, the glow disappears.*Bioluminescence creates its own light, while fluorescence is a
mirror, it needs light to show light.*

### Do Light Bio Bioluminescent Petunias need special treatment to glow?

No special chemicals or "tricks" are required. These plants produce their own light naturally from
within!

To keep their glow at its brightest, they simply need the same love you’d give any favorite plant:
plenty of sunlight to recharge their energy, regular watering, and consistent feeding. Just like us,
the healthier and more nourished the plant is, the more brilliantly it will shine.

### Which parts of the plant glow?

The entire plant is bioluminescent, but the youngest flowers and new growth are the brightest. As
flowers age, their light naturally fades.

### When do they glow?

Light Bio Petunias are bioluminescent 24/7, though their soft light is only visible to the human eye
in total darkness.

### What is the best way to experience the glow?

For the most magical experience, view your Light Bio Bioluminescent Petunias in total
darkness—ideally a pitch-black room or a moonlit-free night.

Eliminate competing light. Even a dim phone screen or a nearby lamp can "blind" you to the
bioluminescence. Turn off all electronics and allow your eyes 5‑10 minutes to fully adjust. You’ll
be amazed at how the soft, steady glow reveals itself as your vision sharpens.

### Can I grow them indoors?

Yes, provided they get several hours of direct sunlight or sit under a bright grow light. Expect
slower growth and fewer blooms during colder months when natural light is limited.

### Is this plant safe for the environment and bees?

Yes. The Firefly Petunia underwent years of rigorous review by the USDA and APHIS and is cleared for
sale across the USA. Because garden petunias have no wild relatives in the U.S., there is no risk of
cross-pollination with native species.

**Official Distribution Notice:** Light Bio is the exclusive global provider of the bioluminescent
technology used in our plants. We sell this technology only in live plant form; we do not offer
seeds, and any third-party seed listings are unauthorized. Genuine products are available only
through this website and our authorized retail partners.

Yes, provided they get several hours of direct sunlight or sit under a bright grow light. Expect
slower growth and fewer blooms during colder months when natural light is limited.

### Is this plant safe for the environment and bees?

Yes. The Firefly Petunia underwent years of rigorous review by the USDA and APHIS and is cleared for
sale across the USA. Because garden petunias have no wild relatives in the U.S., there is no risk of
cross-pollination with native species.

**Official Distribution Notice:** Light Bio is the exclusive global provider of the bioluminescent
technology used in our plants. We sell this technology only in live plant form; we do not offer
seeds, and any third-party seed listings are unauthorized. Genuine products are available only
through this website and our authorized retail partners.

## About NCCS

NCCS The National Centre for Cell Science (NCCS), an autonomous organisation aided by the Department
of Biotechnology, Government of India, was established to facilitate cell biology research in the
country. NCCS is located within the academically-enriched campus of the Savitribai Phule Pune
University (SPPU). Since its inception, NCCS has been performing cutting-edge research in cell
biology, providing valuable services as a national animal cell repository, and supporting human
resource development through various teaching and training programmes.

## About NCCS

NCCS The National Centre for Cell Science (NCCS), an autonomous organisation aided by the Department
of Biotechnology, Government of India, was established to facilitate cell biology research in the
country. NCCS is located within the academically-enriched campus of the Savitribai Phule Pune
University (SPPU). Since its inception, NCCS has been performing cutting-edge research in cell
biology, providing valuable services as a national animal cell repository, and supporting human
resource development through various teaching and training programmes.

# Life-changing therapies
# without a lifetime of
# development

Precision for Medicine solves the most complex clinical development challenges to bring innovative
therapies to patients. [ Contact Us ][153]

No one who is working to help patients in need should be subjected to unnecessary delays during
clinical development and commercialization. Precision’s integrated capabilities, responsive
operations and deep scientific expertise are helping life science innovators accelerate research and
development while reducing cost and increasing the probability of approval.

## Specialized capabilities for every stage of clinical development

Leverage an integrated infrastructure that reduces the inefficiencies inherent in complex
development. Integrate lab and trial execution to increase speed to market. Precision brings a
holistic view to your program's unique needs.

## The approved treatment for big five CRO Fatigue

Precision is a right-sized CRO and the antidote to the widespread exhaustion that can come from
dealing with a big five CRO. We specialize in the unique needs of complex trials. Our people are
assigned to no more than 2 or 3 trials at a time, so you get the attention you need, when you need
it. Find out more about how Precision beats Big Five Fatigue.

# Life-changing therapies
# without a lifetime of
# development

Precision for Medicine solves the most complex clinical development challenges to bring innovative
therapies to patients. [ Contact Us ][153]

No one who is working to help patients in need should be subjected to unnecessary delays during
clinical development and commercialization. Precision’s integrated capabilities, responsive
operations and deep scientific expertise are helping life science innovators accelerate research and
development while reducing cost and increasing the probability of approval.

## Specialized capabilities for every stage of clinical development

Leverage an integrated infrastructure that reduces the inefficiencies inherent in complex
development. Integrate lab and trial execution to increase speed to market. Precision brings a
holistic view to your program's unique needs.
