##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.

[Starmeric®]
[Starmeric® Logo]

[ZeaLutein®]
[ZeaLutein® Logo]

ZeaLutein® is a brick-red proprietary blend of naturally sourced 1% Zeaxanthin, 5% Lutein and 2%
Piperine derived from *Tagetes erecta* (marigold), and *Piper nigrum* (black pepper).

[Cococin®]
[Cococin® Logo]

coconuts (*Cocos nucifera*).  In view of its inherent nutritional significance, it has been rightly
trademarked as “The Nourishment Factor®”, offering a valuable nutrient pool for enhancing food and
beverage formulations.

 

[Bacopin®]
[Bacopin® Logo]

herb traditionally used to support memory and cognitive health. It is standardized to contain
Bacosides, the key active compounds associated with its beneficial effects, to support healthy brain
function. Bacopin**®** is available in different strengths standardized to 20%, 40%, and 50%
Bacosides.

[Boswellin® Super]

[LivLonga®]
[LivLonga® Logo]

LivLonga® from Sabinsa is a US patented, unique blend of three scientifically validated natural
ingredients, including Curcumin C3 Complex® (*Curcuma longa *extract), Livinol® (*Garcinia indica
*extract), and the bioavailability enhancer BioPerine® (*Piper nigrum *extract), to support healthy
liver function.

[Intersection of Research and Revolutionary Ideas]
[Intersection of Research and Revolutionary Ideas]

## The Intersection of Research and Revolutionary Ideas

The R&D center is a true innovation epicenter, which focuses onfinding ways to constantly improve
productivity, cost reduction, quality, and new product development without sacrificing the science
behind its research. To achieve this, several independent divisions use a synergistic approach by
working together to profile the product, ensuring it meets international standards.

[Know More][45]

## Turning Ideas into Reality

With a combination of planning, action, and perseverance, we are turning ideas into reality.

[Know More][46]
01

### Research

Our R&D center drives improvements in productivity, cost reduction, and innovation.

02

### Manufacturing

Sabinsa manufactures its products as per global standards at its eight state-of-the-art
manufacturing facilities located in the US and India.

03

### Quality Control

Sabinsa operates its own quality control, investing in advanced analytical equipment, mass
spectrometry, & liquid chromatography analyzers.

04

### Success Story

For 37 years, Sabinsa has launched 130+ standardized botanical extracts and funded clinical studies
with top institutions to support these products.

05

### Global Presence

Sabinsa has a global presence with offices in the USA, Europe, Brazil, Japan, and India, serving
over 100 countries.

06

### Innovation

Sabinsa is committed to innovation, continuously developing new products and improving existing ones
to meet global health needs.

[Sustainability]

## Sustainability

Sabinsa has adopted four fundamental sustainability tenets.

**HUMAN SUSTAINABILITY:** Sabinsa is mindful of the well-being of its workforce and maximizing their
potential. The company strives to motivate its team to be resilient, inclusive and high-performing
at work.

[Know More][47]
[Dr. Muhammed Majeed]
[Sabinsa | Leading Standardized Herbal Extracts Manufacturer & Supplier]

## Founder's Desk

The Late Dr. Muhammed Majeed was born and raised in Kerala, India. He had over 45+ years of
experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, molecular biology, nutritional, and cosmetic
industries.

As a researcher, scientist, entrepreneur, and business leader, Dr. Majeed pioneered the development
of standardized herbal extracts from India’s Ayurvedic plants and created a global market for them.
He founded and, for 36 years, led Sabinsa into becoming a leading leading multinational health &
life sciences company.

[Know More][48]

## Global Presence

Sabinsa upholds a robust global presence, with offices and facilities across multiple continents to
serve clients in the health and nutrition industry.

We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

# FULL SPECTRUM OF
# FLOW CYTOMETRY SYSTEMS
* [BENCHTOP FLOW CYTOMETER][35]
* •
* [CYTOMETER AUTOMATION][36]

[Stratedigm Flow Cytometer Automation Suite Cartoon]
[magnifying glass, sensitivity icon]

## Sensitivity & Resolution

The [S1000EON flow cytometer][37] has a TRUE 5-decade dynamic range. In tandem with our patent
pending laser-trimming technology and a dedicated microparticle mode, you can detect particles from
0.2 µm to 7 µm all in the same sample.

[ Learn
More][38]
[1 + 1, ease of use icon]

## Ease of Use
## 

We believe that a user-friendly software is essential to any great flow instrument. With
[CellCapTure][39], our full analysis and acquisition software, we made it possible to run a single
tube or run hundreds of 384-well plates with just a few clicks.


[ Learn
More][40]
[Slider scales, scalable icon]

## Configurable & Scalable

Every lab has different needs and budgets. Our S1000 cytometers are completely customizable at time
of purchase and field-upgradeable. Configure your S1000 cytometer with up to 6 lasers and 30
parameters running single tubes or add automation and run hundreds of plates with ease.

[ Configure Your Product][41]
[Blasting off rocket, future-proof icon]

## Future-Proof

We’ve engineered a field-upgradeable and backwards compatible series of flow cytometers. The unique
patented architecture of Stratedigm’s products allows for flexible, incremental upgrades to your
Stratedigm [S1000 series flow cytometer][42]—now or in the future. With our [Anti-Obsolescence
Guarantee][43], we’ve got you covered.

[ Learn
More][44]
[Shield with crossing wrenches, service and warranty icon]

## Service & Warranty

We take great pride in our service. We utilize industrial IoT to resolve and solve 95% of issues in
minutes. And only Stratedigm offers a standard two-year warranty with every [S1000][45], [A600
HTAS][46], and [A710 HTH][47]. The [Flowraissance ][48]program boosts your warranty with a
complimentary upgrade to our latest S1000 cytometer hardware and software.

[ Learn
More][49]
[blank]

## Made in the U.S.A

We develop and manufacture [Stratedigm’s S1000 cytometers][50], [A600 plate loader][51], [A640 cell
prep module][52], [A710 hotel][53], and [A810 incubator][54] in the heart of Silicon Valley. Being
based in this innovative hub allows us to tap into top-tier technology and talent, and ensure
high-quality products while supporting local jobs and the American manufacturing community.

## Stratedigm on the News

[blank]

Find out about Stratedigm’s latest release, the A810, featured on [Business Insider][55].

[Tech Times Logo]

Discover Stratedigm’s future-proof Flow Cytometer model on [Tech Times][56].

Latest News
[[Stratedigm at CYTO 2026: The Next Wave Without Starting Over]][57][Stratedigm at CYTO 2026: The
Next Wave Without Starting Over][58]
May 6, 2026CYTO 2026 is centered on “The Next Wave” in cytometry: exciting new technologies, new
capabilities, and what comes next. Yet for many labs, it means replacing instruments and rebuilding
panels, often at the expense of value built over years. What if it didn’t? At this year’s
conference, Stratedigm (Booth 408) will share a different approach: platforms designed to evolve
with your work instead of forcing replacement. Visit us to learn how teams are: Expanding
capabilities without disrupting existing workflows Running both conventional and spectral analysis
on the same system Extending the useful life of their cytometers by design, not by replacement
cycles  If you’re evaluating what comes next, it’s worth comparing the long-term value of replacing
vs. evolving your current system. Come talk with our team about what this could look like in your
lab. 📍 Visit us at Booth 408 to meet our team and get an up-close look at the future of cytometry.
We can’t wait to show you what’s possible when innovation meets reliability. Connect and continue
the conversation with us on LinkedIn. To learn more about our future-proof instruments with
investment protection, please contact in**@********gm.com, visit us at our website, or our YouTube
Channel. [...] [Read more...][59]

the Spectra platform. This year’s theme, “Reaching New Heights,” perfectly reflects
what Spectra delivers: elevated performance, unmatched flexibility, and scalable design built for

our Flowraissance program and Anti-Obsolescence Guarantee, even our earliest systems can be upgraded

built with your long-term success in mind. 📍 Visit us at Booth 710 to meet our team and get an

[[Coming Soon the S1000EON Spectra: The Future of Flow Cytometry]][63][Coming Soon the S1000EON
Spectra: The Future of Flow Cytometry][64]
April 22, 2025The S1000EON Spectra is poised to redefine what’s possible in flow cytometry. Designed
to support both conventional and spectral modes, this next-generation cytometer combines unmatched
flexibility with cutting-edge precision, pushing the limits of your research capabilities. Here’s a
sneak peek at what the S1000EON Spectra will bring to the table: Conventional and Spectral Flow
Cytometry – Switch effortlessly between both modes for ultimate versatility in your analyses. Up to
6 Lasers – Unlock powerful spectral capabilities to elevate your results. 45 Parameters – Gain
deeper insights and expand your analytical reach with increased parameter options. Refined Spatial
Resolution – Capture more detailed and accurate data with each laser having its own dedicated spot
for improved spatial separation. Gen 2.0 Microparticle Mode – Experience next-level precision in
microparticle analysis with enhanced sensitivity and performance. Up to 6 SSC Channels – Expand your
ability to analyze side scatter signals, providing deeper detail into cellular complexity and
morphology with additional channels. Up to 6 FSC Channels – Capture a broader range of forward
scatter signals for more detailed size-based insights across multiple channels. The S1000EON Spectra
is engineered to grow with your needs, ensuring you stay ahead of the curve in a constantly evolving
field. Stay tuned for more updates as we prepare to introduce the next big leap in flow cytometry
innovation. [...] [Read more...][65]

# FLOW CYTOMETRY SYSTEMS

* •
* [CYTOMETER AUTOMATION][36]

[Stratedigm Flow Cytometer Automation Suite Cartoon]
[magnifying glass, sensitivity icon]

## Sensitivity & Resolution

The [S1000EON flow cytometer][37] has a TRUE 5-decade dynamic range. In tandem with our patent
pending laser-trimming technology and a dedicated microparticle mode, you can detect particles from
0.2 µm to 7 µm all in the same sample.

[ Learn
More][38]
[1 + 1, ease of use icon]

## Ease of Use
## 

We believe that a user-friendly software is essential to any great flow instrument. With
[CellCapTure][39], our full analysis and acquisition software, we made it possible to run a single
tube or run hundreds of 384-well plates with just a few clicks.


[ Learn
More][40]
[Slider scales, scalable icon]

## Configurable & Scalable

Every lab has different needs and budgets. Our S1000 cytometers are completely customizable at time
of purchase and field-upgradeable. Configure your S1000 cytometer with up to 6 lasers and 30
parameters running single tubes or add automation and run hundreds of plates with ease.

[ Configure Your Product][41]
[Blasting off rocket, future-proof icon]

## Future-Proof

We’ve engineered a field-upgradeable and backwards compatible series of flow cytometers. The unique
patented architecture of Stratedigm’s products allows for flexible, incremental upgrades to your
Stratedigm [S1000 series flow cytometer][42]—now or in the future. With our [Anti-Obsolescence
Guarantee][43], we’ve got you covered.

[ Learn
More][44]
[Shield with crossing wrenches, service and warranty icon]

## Service & Warranty

We take great pride in our service. We utilize industrial IoT to resolve and solve 95% of issues in
minutes. And only Stratedigm offers a standard two-year warranty with every [S1000][45], [A600
HTAS][46], and [A710 HTH][47]. The [Flowraissance ][48]program boosts your warranty with a
complimentary upgrade to our latest S1000 cytometer hardware and software.

[ Learn
More][49]
[blank]

## Made in the U.S.A

We develop and manufacture [Stratedigm’s S1000 cytometers][50], [A600 plate loader][51], [A640 cell
prep module][52], [A710 hotel][53], and [A810 incubator][54] in the heart of Silicon Valley. Being
based in this innovative hub allows us to tap into top-tier technology and talent, and ensure
high-quality products while supporting local jobs and the American manufacturing community.

## Stratedigm on the News

[blank]

Find out about Stratedigm’s latest release, the A810, featured on [Business Insider][55].

[Tech Times Logo]

Discover Stratedigm’s future-proof Flow Cytometer model on [Tech Times][56].

Latest News
[[Stratedigm at CYTO 2026: The Next Wave Without Starting Over]][57][Stratedigm at CYTO 2026: The
Next Wave Without Starting Over][58]
May 6, 2026CYTO 2026 is centered on “The Next Wave” in cytometry: exciting new technologies, new
capabilities, and what comes next. Yet for many labs, it means replacing instruments and rebuilding
panels, often at the expense of value built over years. What if it didn’t? At this year’s
conference, Stratedigm (Booth 408) will share a different approach: platforms designed to evolve
with your work instead of forcing replacement. Visit us to learn how teams are: Expanding
capabilities without disrupting existing workflows Running both conventional and spectral analysis
on the same system Extending the useful life of their cytometers by design, not by replacement
cycles  If you’re evaluating what comes next, it’s worth comparing the long-term value of replacing
vs. evolving your current system. Come talk with our team about what this could look like in your
lab. 📍 Visit us at Booth 408 to meet our team and get an up-close look at the future of cytometry.
We can’t wait to show you what’s possible when innovation meets reliability. Connect and continue
the conversation with us on LinkedIn. To learn more about our future-proof instruments with
investment protection, please contact in**@********gm.com, visit us at our website, or our YouTube
Channel. [...] [Read more...][59]

what Spectra delivers: elevated performance, unmatched flexibility, and scalable design built for

[[Coming Soon the S1000EON Spectra: The Future of Flow Cytometry]][63][Coming Soon the S1000EON
Spectra: The Future of Flow Cytometry][64]
April 22, 2025The S1000EON Spectra is poised to redefine what’s possible in flow cytometry. Designed
to support both conventional and spectral modes, this next-generation cytometer combines unmatched
flexibility with cutting-edge precision, pushing the limits of your research capabilities. Here’s a
sneak peek at what the S1000EON Spectra will bring to the table: Conventional and Spectral Flow
Cytometry – Switch effortlessly between both modes for ultimate versatility in your analyses. Up to
6 Lasers – Unlock powerful spectral capabilities to elevate your results. 45 Parameters – Gain
deeper insights and expand your analytical reach with increased parameter options. Refined Spatial
Resolution – Capture more detailed and accurate data with each laser having its own dedicated spot
for improved spatial separation. Gen 2.0 Microparticle Mode – Experience next-level precision in
microparticle analysis with enhanced sensitivity and performance. Up to 6 SSC Channels – Expand your
ability to analyze side scatter signals, providing deeper detail into cellular complexity and
morphology with additional channels. Up to 6 FSC Channels – Capture a broader range of forward
scatter signals for more detailed size-based insights across multiple channels. The S1000EON Spectra
is engineered to grow with your needs, ensuring you stay ahead of the curve in a constantly evolving
field. Stay tuned for more updates as we prepare to introduce the next big leap in flow cytometry
innovation. [...] [Read more...][65]

# Shaping the Future of Flow Cytometry Education—Together

[ Single User Plans ][50]
[ Institutional Access ][51]

** SuperNova Flow Cytometry delivers Flow Cytometry Training** for all levels—from first-time
learners to institutional leaders

—helping you earn CMLE credits, prepare for certification, and drive biomedical discovery forward.

## Built by Scientists, For Scientists

At SuperNova Flow Cytometry, we know the challenges of mastering complex technologies. With over a
decade of teaching experience at NIH, NCI, and the U.S. Naval Academy, our team created a platform
that transforms cytometry education into something **accessible, accredited, and impactful.**

** **

[🎓] **Accredited & Recognized** – Earn [CMLE credits][52] accepted by ASCP to maintain
certification and compliance.

[📘] **Education for Every Level** – From beginners to advanced scientists and core directors, our
courses meet learners where they are.

[🔬] **Certification & Career Ready** – Curriculum aligned with [SCYM(ASCP) certification][53] and
industry standards for lab excellence.

 

**Whether you’re starting your journey or leading a lab, SuperNova Flow Cytometry equips you for
success.**

## Why Choose Accredited Flow Cytometry Training?

Our Accredited Flow Cytometry Training is vendor-neutral and aligned with FDA, CLSI H62, and ICH Q2
standards. Learners gain access to validated SOPs, expert webinars, and SCYM exam preparation
support, trusted by cytometrists worldwide.

#### Recognized by

## Ready to Transform Your Flow Cytometry Learning?

Join scientists worldwide advancing their expertise through accredited, accessible education.
**Whether you’re an individual learner or an organization, core facility, CRO, or university team**,
SuperNova Flow Cytometry offers flexible plans that scale to your needs. Choose the plan that fits
your journey, empower your team with vendor-neutral training, and start your **Accredited Flow
Cytometry Training** today to earn CMLE credits and strengthen compliance.

[ See Institutional Solutions ][55]

**SuperNova**** Flow Cytometry is an independent educational provider with no affiliation,

## Let's democratize flow cytometry, join the movement

Synexa specialises in biomarker and bioanalytical services which can be specifically tailored to
suit both the modality of the therapeutic and the disease area of focus. Autoimmune conditions are
highly heterogenous, affecting numerous cell types, molecular pathways and tissues, necessitating
multi-pronged approaches integrating technology platforms including targeted genetic analysis,
soluble biomarkers and flow cytometry.

## Our Services

### [Translational][93]

Reduce clinical trial risk by validating your therapeutic’s biology in human disease models. We
generate mechanistic data from fresh patient samples that predicts clinical response, guides
biomarker strategy, and strengthens regulatory submissions before you enter the clinic.
[ Consultation ][94]
[ Explore service ][95]
[ ][96]

### [Soluble Biomarkers][97]

Your biomarker strategy determines what data you collect and what regulatory questions you can
answer. We develop custom biomarker panels that measure what matters: target engagement, pathway
modulation, disease activity, and the clinical signals that drive development decisions from Phase I
through approval.

[ Consultation ][98]
[ Explore service ][99]

### [Regulated Bioanalysis][100]

Complex therapeutics require specialised bioanalytical methods. We develop and validate bespoke
assays supporting PK, TK, PD, immunogenicity, and related bioanalytical endpoints, leveraging over
20 years of expertise in LC‑MS/MS, MSD, and immunoassay platforms. Our rigorous validation process
ensures your data meets regulatory requirements.
[ Consultation ][101]
[ Explore service ][102]

### [Mass Spectrometry][103]

Accelerate your bioanalysis with precise LC‑MS/MS quantification of small molecules, peptides,
proteins, and ADCs. Our dedicated 16,500 sq ft UK facility delivers rapid, ICH M10‑validated PK, TK,
and biomarker analysis from discovery through clinical development, with the GLP/GCP compliance and
turnaround speed your programmes require.

[ Consultation ][104]
[ Explore service ][105]

### [Immunoassay Services][106]

Developing large‑molecule biotherapeutics requires sensitive, validated immunoassays you can trust.
We design bespoke ligand‑binding assays for PK, ADA, and biomarker quantification, delivering the
precision and GCP/GLP compliance needed for confident regulatory decision‑making.

[ Consultation ][107]
[ Explore service ][108]
[ [Scientist examining a laboratory sample] ][109]

### [Proteomics][110]

Discover protein biomarker signatures with minimal sample. Using Olink’s Proximity Extension Assay
technology, we analyse up to 92 proteins from just 1 µL, delivering the sensitivity, specificity,
and multiplexing power needed for biomarker discovery, patient stratification, and
mechanism‑of‑action studies.
[ Consultation ][111]
[ Explore service ][112]
[ ][113]

### [Flow Cytometry][114]

From immunophenotyping rare cells to measuring target engagement and immune function, our custom
flow cytometry panels deliver validated, high‑parameter analysis. Designed to CLSI H62 standards and
tailored to your endpoints, our assays provide the reproducible cellular insights that guide
therapeutic development decisions.

[ Consultation ][115]
[ Explore service ][116]
[ [test tubes being filled] ][117]

### [ELISpot Assay Services][118]

Measure antigen‑specific immune responses at single‑cell resolution. Our GCLP‑compliant ELISpot
assays detect low‑frequency T‑cell and B‑cell responses critical for vaccine development,
immunotherapy monitoring, and CAR‑T assessment. From custom assay design to data analysis, we
deliver the sensitive, validated cytokine detection your immune monitoring trials depend on.

[ Consultation ][119]
[ Explore service ][120]

### [Radiopharmaceutical Bioanalysis][121]

Advancing radiopharmaceutical therapies requires specialised bioanalytical expertise. Our
GMP/GLP‑accredited Turku facility handles Ac‑225, Th‑227, I‑131, and other radioisotopes, providing
radioactive sample management, PK analysis, and immunogenicity testing with full regulatory
compliance. Licensed and experienced in this specialised field for 15+ years.
[ Consultation ][122]
[ Explore service ][123]
[ [Scientists analysing DNA data together][Scientists analysing DNA data together] ][124]

### [Genomics][125]

From gene therapy biodistribution to CAR‑T persistence, our GCLP‑accredited genomics services
deliver the precision you need. We provide SNP detection, qPCR, ddPCR, targeted sequencing, and
ctDNA quantification, supporting cell therapy bioanalysis, viral shedding studies, and
pharmacogenomics across diverse sample matrices.
[ Consultation ][126]
[ Explore service ][127]

### [Tissue Imaging][128]

Understand how therapeutics behave within complex tissue microenvironments. Our spatial biology
services, including multiplex immunofluorescence, super‑resolution microscopy, and CLEM, reveal
cellular organisation, target engagement, and off‑target effects in situ. From drug candidate
selection to mechanism‑of‑action studies, we deliver the tissue‑level insights that predict clinical
success.
[ Consultation ][129]
[ Explore service ][130]

### [Dose Formulation Analysis][131]

GLP toxicology studies require verified dose formulation concentrations. Our Manchester facility
verifies formulation accuracy and stability, ensuring regulatory submissions meet requirements. We
validate concentration, consistency, and shelf‑life using proven analytical methods.

[ Consultation ][132]
[ Explore service ][133]

Synexa specialises in biomarker and bioanalytical services which can be specifically tailored to
suit both the modality of the therapeutic and the disease area of focus. Autoimmune conditions are
highly heterogenous, affecting numerous cell types, molecular pathways and tissues, necessitating
multi-pronged approaches integrating technology platforms including targeted genetic analysis,
soluble biomarkers and flow cytometry.

# [What is Large Particle Flow Cytometry?][74]

[[What is Large Particle Flow Cytometry?]][75]

Union Biometrica provides flow cytometry for objects that are too large / too fragile for
traditional cytometers and offer an alternative to manual sorting (under a microscope). These
systems sort and dispense objects based on size and fluorescent parameters. Automating this process
offers increased speed, sensitivity, quantification, and repeatability of experiments.

Systems for the automated analysis and sorting of viable multicellular organisms, cells and other
large “particles” sized from 10–1,500 microns.

[**Learn More »**][76]

[[The Throughput Engine for NAMs]][77]

## [The Throughput Engine for NAMs][78]

Union Biometrica, Inc.’s **Large Particle Flow Cytometry** technology is a high-throughput platform
designed to analyze and sort intact 3D biological structures – hundreds of microns in size – without
destroying them.
* **Sort **live organoids, spheroids, and small model organisms based on size, morphology,
  fluorescence, viability, or engineered reporters while keeping them intact and functional

[**Learn More »**][79]

[[The Organoid Sorter]][80]

## [The Organoid Sorter][81]
* **Scale **from dozens to tens of thousands of organoids per run, accelerating screening, culturing
  processes, and QC workflows
* **Standardize **3D biology with consistent, quantifiable inputs
* **Eliminate **subjective, manual picking, which leads to variability in organoid-based assays

[**Learn More »**][82]

[[Spheroid Sorting and Plate Dispensing]][83]

## [Spheroid Sorting and Plate Dispensing][84]
* **Sort** spheroids based on size (Time of Flight – TOF), optical density (Extinction), and
  Fluorescence
* **Dispense** GFP+ spheroids into multi-well plates
* **Produce** 96-well plates where every well contains one uniform GFP+ spheroid

[**Learn More »**][85]

[[Organoid Batch Analysis]][86]

## [Organoid Batch Analysis][87]

Using the COPAS Vision™
* Acquire **population-level** and **object-level** data on organoid cultures
* Collect **1000s** of brightfield images in flow
* Compare batches across days, conditions, and research sites

[**Learn More »**][88]

[[Large Particle Imaging Flow Cytometry for 3D Biological Models]][89]

## [Large Particle Imaging Flow Cytometry for 3D Biological Models][90]
* The **COPAS Vision™** captures brightfield images in flow
* Acquire **cytometry, Profiler™, and image data** at the same time
* Correlate phenotype to cytometry data
* Image analysis data include measurements of object size, width, height, smoothness and more!

[**Learn More »**][91]

* The **COPAS Vision™** captures brightfield images in flow
* Acquire **cytometry, Profiler™, and image data** at the same time
* Correlate phenotype to cytometry data

[[Imaging Flow Cytometry for Embryo Models]][92]

## [Imaging Flow Cytometry for Embryo Models][93]
* **Blastocysts** are structures that form early in embryogenesis shortly following fertilization
* **Human blastocysts** are made up of about 100-200 cells, they are typically 100-200 microns in
  diameter and can be analyzed on our COPAS instruments. 
* **The COPAS Vision equipped with a 500 micron flow cell** was used to acquire cytometric data and
  brightfield image data from mouse blastocysts produced under various conditions as described
  in *Dura et al. (EMBO J. 2025)*

[**Learn More »**][94]

[[Co-cultured Spheroids – Profiler Analysis]][95]

## [Co-cultured Spheroids – Profiler Analysis][96]
* Tumor cells grown in spheroids may provide more predictive models for tumor biology than monolayer
  cultures
* **Profiler™** data generated by the **COPAS Vision 1000** were used to characterize the
  localization of three cell types in cultured spheroids as described in *Shah et al. (J. of
  Liposome Res. 2025)*
* **Brightfield images** (inset) were captured in flow

[**Learn More »**][97]

[[Pluripotent iPSC Cluster Sorting]][98]

## [Pluripotent iPSC Cluster Sorting][99]
* Picking induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) clusters remains largely manual and
  technique-dependent
* The **COPAS FP-1000** was used to sort ~ 1mm iPSC clusters as described in *Ma et al. (Front.
  Bioeng. Biotechnol. 2022)*
* **Pluripotency** was preserved following cluster harvest, sorting, and passage

[**Learn More »**][100]

[[Viable Cardiomyocyte Sorting]][101]

## [Viable Cardiomyocyte Sorting][102]
* **Cardiomyocytes** – and other cells that are long, skinny, and fragile – are challenging to sort
  using traditional FACS
* **Large Particle Flow Cytometry** is suited to carry out single cell sorting of viable and
  functional cardiomyocytes as described in *Kannan et al. (Circulatory Research 2019)*
* Enables single-cell transcriptomics of cells not amenable to traditional isolation methods

[**Learn More »**][103]

[[Adipocyte Sorting]][104]

## [Adipocyte Sorting][105]
* **Adipocytes** – and cells that are large and prone to rupture – are challenging to sort using
  traditional FACS
* The **BioSorter** equipped with a 500 micron flow cell is suited to carry out single-cell sorting
  and analysis of adipocytes as described in *Wang et al. (Nat. Commun. 2020)*
* Enabled comparison of adipocyte size distribution between WT and KO mice

[**Learn More »**][106]

[[Automated Environmental Surveys ]][107]

## [Automated Environmental Surveys ][108]
* Count, image, and identify organisms to measure **biodiversity**
* *Marine plankton*
* *Freshwater meiofauna*
* *Soil micro- and meso-biota*
* **Sort **organisms of interest for library creation, sequencing, or DNA barcoding

[**Learn More »**][109]

[[Mosquito Larvae Counting & Sex Separation]][110]

## [Mosquito Larvae Counting & Sex Separation][111]
* **Count** and **sort** thousands of mosquito larvae
* Analyze and dispense populations based on **fluorescence expression**
* Enables accurate, large scale sex separation for **Sterile Insect Technique (SIT)** measures

[**Learn More »**][112]

[[Automated Zebrafish Phenotypic Screening]][113]

## [Automated Zebrafish Phenotypic Screening][114]
* The Vertebrate Automated Screening Technology (**VAST**) automates loading, orientation, and
  position **2-7 dpf zebrafish**
* **Image **with on board camera for whole body/organ resolution
* **Mount **to a microscope for cellular resolution imaging
* Enables scale-up, improving reproducibility while reducing manual handling

[**Learn More »**][115]

[[A great presentation at the MIW!]][116]

## [A great presentation at the MIW!][117]


[**Learn More »**][118]

[[Large particle imaging flow cytometry and plate-based sorting of intact 3D models to support
reproducible new approach methodologies]][119]

## [Large particle imaging flow cytometry and plate-based sorting of intact 3D models to support
## reproducible new approach methodologies][120]
* Large particle imaging flow cytometry enables quantitative analysis and precision dispensing of
  **intact 3D models** while preserving biological context.
* Integrated cytometric, imaging, and Profiler-based measurements support **reproducible
  characterization** of spheroid populations without dissociation.
* **Cryopreserved spheroids** can be distinguished from debris, analyzed at population scale, and
  dispensed into assay-ready multi-well plate formats.
* **Drug response assays** performed on intact cryopreserved spheroids demonstrate the utility of
  this platform for standardized and scalable 3D model workflows.
* These capabilities support the growing need for reproducible, high-throughput workflows aligned
  with **NAM** initiatives.

[**Learn More »**][121]

[[Workflow capabilities for New World Screwworm eggs and larvae]][122]

## [Workflow capabilities for New World Screwworm eggs and larvae][123]
* **Count and sort screwworm** eggs and larvae for accurate quantification
* **Analyze and dispense **for assays that use multiwell plate formats
* **Fluorescence measurements **of transgenic variants with applications to SIT and pesticide
  screening

[**Learn More »**][124]

# [What is Large Particle Flow Cytometry?][74]

[[What is Large Particle Flow Cytometry?]][75]

Union Biometrica provides flow cytometry for objects that are too large / too fragile for
traditional cytometers and offer an alternative to manual sorting (under a microscope). These
systems sort and dispense objects based on size and fluorescent parameters. Automating this process
offers increased speed, sensitivity, quantification, and repeatability of experiments.

Systems for the automated analysis and sorting of viable multicellular organisms, cells and other
large “particles” sized from 10–1,500 microns.

[**Learn More »**][76]

[[The Throughput Engine for NAMs]][77]

## [The Throughput Engine for NAMs][78]

Union Biometrica, Inc.’s **Large Particle Flow Cytometry** technology is a high-throughput platform
designed to analyze and sort intact 3D biological structures – hundreds of microns in size – without
destroying them.
* **Sort **live organoids, spheroids, and small model organisms based on size, morphology,
  fluorescence, viability, or engineered reporters while keeping them intact and functional

[**Learn More »**][79]

[[The Organoid Sorter]][80]

## [The Organoid Sorter][81]
* **Scale **from dozens to tens of thousands of organoids per run, accelerating screening, culturing
  processes, and QC workflows
* **Standardize **3D biology with consistent, quantifiable inputs
* **Eliminate **subjective, manual picking, which leads to variability in organoid-based assays

[**Learn More »**][82]

[[Spheroid Sorting and Plate Dispensing]][83]

## [Spheroid Sorting and Plate Dispensing][84]
* **Sort** spheroids based on size (Time of Flight – TOF), optical density (Extinction), and
  Fluorescence
* **Dispense** GFP+ spheroids into multi-well plates
* **Produce** 96-well plates where every well contains one uniform GFP+ spheroid

[**Learn More »**][85]

[[Organoid Batch Analysis]][86]

## [Organoid Batch Analysis][87]

Using the COPAS Vision™
* Acquire **population-level** and **object-level** data on organoid cultures
* Collect **1000s** of brightfield images in flow
* Compare batches across days, conditions, and research sites

[**Learn More »**][88]

[[Large Particle Imaging Flow Cytometry for 3D Biological Models]][89]

## [Large Particle Imaging Flow Cytometry for 3D Biological Models][90]
* The **COPAS Vision™** captures brightfield images in flow
* Acquire **cytometry, Profiler™, and image data** at the same time
* Correlate phenotype to cytometry data
* Image analysis data include measurements of object size, width, height, smoothness and more!

[**Learn More »**][91]

[[Imaging Flow Cytometry for Embryo Models]][92]

## [Imaging Flow Cytometry for Embryo Models][93]
* **Blastocysts** are structures that form early in embryogenesis shortly following fertilization
* **Human blastocysts** are made up of about 100-200 cells, they are typically 100-200 microns in
  diameter and can be analyzed on our COPAS instruments. 
* **The COPAS Vision equipped with a 500 micron flow cell** was used to acquire cytometric data and
  brightfield image data from mouse blastocysts produced under various conditions as described
  in *Dura et al. (EMBO J. 2025)*

[**Learn More »**][94]

[[Co-cultured Spheroids – Profiler Analysis]][95]

## [Co-cultured Spheroids – Profiler Analysis][96]
* Tumor cells grown in spheroids may provide more predictive models for tumor biology than monolayer
  cultures
* **Profiler™** data generated by the **COPAS Vision 1000** were used to characterize the
  localization of three cell types in cultured spheroids as described in *Shah et al. (J. of
  Liposome Res. 2025)*
* **Brightfield images** (inset) were captured in flow

[**Learn More »**][97]

[[Pluripotent iPSC Cluster Sorting]][98]

## [Pluripotent iPSC Cluster Sorting][99]
* Picking induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) clusters remains largely manual and
  technique-dependent
* The **COPAS FP-1000** was used to sort ~ 1mm iPSC clusters as described in *Ma et al. (Front.
  Bioeng. Biotechnol. 2022)*
* **Pluripotency** was preserved following cluster harvest, sorting, and passage

[**Learn More »**][100]

[[Viable Cardiomyocyte Sorting]][101]

## [Viable Cardiomyocyte Sorting][102]
* **Cardiomyocytes** – and other cells that are long, skinny, and fragile – are challenging to sort
  using traditional FACS
* **Large Particle Flow Cytometry** is suited to carry out single cell sorting of viable and
  functional cardiomyocytes as described in *Kannan et al. (Circulatory Research 2019)*
* Enables single-cell transcriptomics of cells not amenable to traditional isolation methods

[**Learn More »**][103]

[[Adipocyte Sorting]][104]

## [Adipocyte Sorting][105]
* **Adipocytes** – and cells that are large and prone to rupture – are challenging to sort using
  traditional FACS
* The **BioSorter** equipped with a 500 micron flow cell is suited to carry out single-cell sorting
  and analysis of adipocytes as described in *Wang et al. (Nat. Commun. 2020)*
* Enabled comparison of adipocyte size distribution between WT and KO mice

[**Learn More »**][106]

[[Automated Environmental Surveys ]][107]

## [Automated Environmental Surveys ][108]
* Count, image, and identify organisms to measure **biodiversity**
* *Marine plankton*
* *Freshwater meiofauna*
* *Soil micro- and meso-biota*
* **Sort **organisms of interest for library creation, sequencing, or DNA barcoding

[**Learn More »**][109]

[[Mosquito Larvae Counting & Sex Separation]][110]

## [Mosquito Larvae Counting & Sex Separation][111]
* **Count** and **sort** thousands of mosquito larvae
* Analyze and dispense populations based on **fluorescence expression**
* Enables accurate, large scale sex separation for **Sterile Insect Technique (SIT)** measures

[**Learn More »**][112]

[[Automated Zebrafish Phenotypic Screening]][113]

## [Automated Zebrafish Phenotypic Screening][114]
* The Vertebrate Automated Screening Technology (**VAST**) automates loading, orientation, and
  position **2-7 dpf zebrafish**
* **Image **with on board camera for whole body/organ resolution
* **Mount **to a microscope for cellular resolution imaging
* Enables scale-up, improving reproducibility while reducing manual handling

[**Learn More »**][115]

[[A great presentation at the MIW!]][116]

## [A great presentation at the MIW!][117]


[**Learn More »**][118]

[[Large particle imaging flow cytometry and plate-based sorting of intact 3D models to support
reproducible new approach methodologies]][119]

## [Large particle imaging flow cytometry and plate-based sorting of intact 3D models to support
## reproducible new approach methodologies][120]
* Large particle imaging flow cytometry enables quantitative analysis and precision dispensing of
  **intact 3D models** while preserving biological context.
* Integrated cytometric, imaging, and Profiler-based measurements support **reproducible
  characterization** of spheroid populations without dissociation.
* **Cryopreserved spheroids** can be distinguished from debris, analyzed at population scale, and
  dispensed into assay-ready multi-well plate formats.
* **Drug response assays** performed on intact cryopreserved spheroids demonstrate the utility of
  this platform for standardized and scalable 3D model workflows.
* These capabilities support the growing need for reproducible, high-throughput workflows aligned
  with **NAM** initiatives.

[**Learn More »**][121]

[[Workflow capabilities for New World Screwworm eggs and larvae]][122]

## [Workflow capabilities for New World Screwworm eggs and larvae][123]
* **Count and sort screwworm** eggs and larvae for accurate quantification
* **Analyze and dispense **for assays that use multiwell plate formats
* **Fluorescence measurements **of transgenic variants with applications to SIT and pesticide
  screening

Grant Merit Extension from the NCI.

## Immunotherapy

**The Vaccine & Immunotherapy Center** focuses the Institute’s strengths in immunology, virology and
immuno-oncology disciplines to improve public health around the globe.

**The Hubert J.P. Schoemaker Education and Training Center** brings all Wistar education and
training programs under a single umbrella to make lasting global impact in biomedical research.

The Problem

## AI Can't Run on *Fragmented Data*

90% of pharma AI pilots stall at the data layer. The bottleneck isn't models — it's the underlying
data infrastructure.

01

### Science isn't the bottleneck. The operating model is.

Manual data integration, ungoverned context, and brittle handoffs between instruments and
informatics systems slow every pipeline decision.

02

### AI initiatives fail at the data layer.

Models require provenance, context, and regulatory-grade governance. Without it, every prediction is
unverifiable and every insight is suspect.

03

### Integration projects don't compound.

Every new instrument, site, or technique starts from scratch. There is no reusable infrastructure.
No shared context. No compounding return.

“The value comes from the masses. We need patterns that solve multiple problems and impact thousands
of people — increasing speed and capacity without proportional cost growth.”

hours and days.”

something crucial: our data needs context.”
